description:
Part-Time Virtual Assistant (Ad-Hoc / Hourly)



Industry: Interior Design & IT



Location: Work From Home (Remote)



Type: Part-Time / Ad-Hoc (Flexible hourly tracking, potential to convert to full-time)



Salary: PHP14,800 - PHP19,700 (Estimated starting monthly/ hourly allocation) depending on work experience



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant (PA) to support the company. This role focuses heavily on administrative paperwork, spreadsheet management, and attending, coordinating communications between client and employer.



Unlike traditional passive assistants, this role requires high proactivity: you will be responsible for keeping track of deadlines, proactively updating (rather than just texting) your employer with reminders, and managing ad-hoc tasks as they arise. You must also be tech-savvy and comfortable utilizing AI tools to streamline workflows. Advantage, if able to speak Mandarin or Hokkien dialect.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Administrative & Paperwork: Handle general admin tasks, document management, and organizational workflows.

Spreadsheet Management: Maintain, update, and organize data accurately in spreadsheets.



Proactive Communication & Reminders: Manage schedules and actively call employer with time-sensitive reminders and updates rather than relying solely on text messages.



Ad-Hoc Task Execution: Complete tasks flexibly on an as-needed basis, tracking hours meticulously 



WHAT YOU NEED

Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (mandatory)



Tech & AI Savviness: Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve efficiency and speed up task completion.



Soft Skills: Highly proactive, patient, organized, and comfortable with direct phone communication.



Setup: A reliable work-from-home setup with a stable internet connection and computer.



HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates may apply by submitting your profile, CV, and a short introduction detailing your administrative experience and familiarity with AI tools.

title: Experienced U.S. Trucking Fleet Manager / Dispatcher – Remote
description:
That Ford Girl Trucking — A Trucking Agency is looking for an experienced Fleet Manager/Dispatcher to join our growing U.S.-based trucking operation.



This is not a virtual assistant position and not an entry-level dispatch position. We are looking for someone who already understands U.S. trucking, freight markets, load boards, broker negotiations, driver management, HOS, trip planning, and how dispatch decisions affect truck revenue.



Your primary responsibility is simple: make good fleet and dispatch decisions, plan ahead, negotiate strong freight, and keep assigned drivers moving safely and productively.



Responsibilities

Search load boards and approved freight sources for profitable loads

Evaluate rates, mileage, deadhead, market conditions, HOS and truck positioning

Negotiate rates with U.S. freight brokers — do not simply accept the first rate offered

Book and dispatch freight

Plan reloads and backhauls before trucks become empty

Monitor driver locations, HOS, appointments and home-time needs

Communicate professionally with drivers and brokers

Handle routine load issues and know when something needs to be escalated

Track detention, layover, TONU and other accessorial situations

Keep fleet/load information updated

Help maximize truck productivity while making sound operational decisions

What We're Looking For



You should have previous hands-on experience dispatching U.S. trucks and be comfortable making decisions independently.



Strong candidates will understand RPM, deadhead, freight markets, rate negotiation, HOS, appointment scheduling and how to position a truck for its next load.



Negotiation ability and revenue awareness are extremely important to us. We want a Fleet Manager who understands that an additional $100–$200 negotiated onto a load matters and is willing to professionally negotiate for the best reasonable rate.



You should also have strong English communication skills, good judgment, organization and the confidence to manage drivers without needing approval for every routine decision.



Schedule & Support



Our general management and operational support hours are 7:30 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time (U.S.).



The Fleet Manager will eventually participate in a shared rotating after-hours coverage schedule with management for legitimate time-sensitive driver/load matters. This rotation is designed so management team members also receive protected off-time.



You will not be expected to run the entire back office yourself. Our Agency has operational and administrative support for onboarding, documentation, compliance coordination, revenue tracking, settlements and other back-office functions. Your primary focus is fleet management, freight procurement, negotiation, dispatch and keeping trucks productive.



Compensation



This position will have performance-based compensation tied directly to qualifying freight personally sourced, negotiated, booked and dispatched by the Fleet Manager.



Specific compensation will be discussed with qualified candidates during the interview process.



How to Apply



Please include:



How many years you have dispatched U.S. trucks.

What equipment types you have dispatched.

Which load boards/TMS platforms you have used.

Approximately how many trucks you have managed at one time.

An example of how you negotiate when a broker's first offer is too low.

Your experience planning reloads/backhauls and managing driver HOS.



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily general VA work with little or no hands-on U.S. truck dispatching experience.

title: SEO and GBP specialist
description:
About LazyJobber



LazyJobber manages Google Business Profiles for local service businesses, including UK tradespeople (plumbers, electricians, HVAC engineers, builders, roofers) and US car detailers. We optimise listings, handle reviews, and work to improve clients' local map rankings. This role supports that work directly.



The Role

Part-time, remote, 12–25 hrs/week, reviewed after a paid trial (see below). As the business grows hours will grow too. We expect you to start around the 12 hrs/week mark or just below that based on work, then over time (and with business growth) rise up steadily as you take on more client work.



What you'll do

- Manage and optimise Google Business Profiles across multiple client accounts: business info accuracy, categories/services, photos, posts, and Q&A

- Respond to Google reviews on behalf of clients, matching each client's tone and brand voice, and handling both glowing reviews and complaints professionally

- Monitor client profiles regularly and flag new reviews promptly

- Handle local SEO upkeep: NAP consistency checks, citation building/cleanup, spot-checking competitor GBPs

- Assist with keyword research and reporting using data and tools we provide

- Highlight key areas which competitors are doing well and how we can catchup

- Follow our SOPs/checklists for GBP work and log completed tasks (Trello/Sheets/Slack)

- Flag issues or opportunities proactively rather than waiting to be asked



What we're looking for

- Excellent written English: clear, warm, and natural. Copy that sounds robotic or obviously AI-generated is an instant no for this role, since it goes out under a real business's name.

- Some hands-on experience managing Google Business Profiles (agency, freelance, or in-house). Strong generalist VAs with adjacent experience will still be considered if they test well.

- Comfortable running multiple client accounts at once without close supervision

- Reliable internet with a backup plan for outages

- Able to commit 15–25 hrs/week with some overlap for team check-ins across UK and US working hours

- Detail-oriented: mistakes here are public and attached to a real business's name



Nice to have

Familiarity with local SEO tools (BrightLocal, Local Falcon, GMB Everywhere, or similar)

Understanding of citations, NAP consistency, and how local map/3-pack rankings work

Experience working with UK, US, or Australian client bases

Agency or white-label experience managing SEO for multiple clients at once



Hours & pay

12hrs/week to start, flexible day-to-day, with agreed overlap hours for team communication

$4-5/hr USD to start, paid via Wise/Payoneer



Rate reviewed after a paid trial task and again after a 30-day trial period, based on performance



How to apply

To confirm you've read this properly, start your application with the word "GBP SEO" and answer:



Tell us about one Google Business Profile you've personally managed. What did you do, and what changed?

Pick any real local service business's Google Business Profile (a tradesperson, car detailer, or similar) and tell us one thing you'd improve about it. Show us a case study for and highlight areas of improvement.



What tools have you used for local SEO / GBP work, if any?



Include your resume/portfolio and your available hours.

title: Video Editor for Food, Travel & Mini-Documentary Content — Ongoing Work
description:
I'm looking for a talented video editor to work with me on food, cocktail, travel and documentary-style content for Instagram, YouTube and Chinese social media.



I'm particularly interested in finding someone for an ongoing working relationship, rather than simply outsourcing a single video.



The first paid project will be Part 2 of a cocktail experiment in which we try to create cocktails using Chinese hotpot ingredients. The finished video will be approximately 2–3 minutes, vertical (9:16).



Reference Video

Please watch the Part 1 reference video before applying:


==



Part 1 establishes the general editing style I'm looking for. I want Part 2 to clearly feel like part of the same series, but I don't want someone to simply copy it.



I'm looking for an editor with strong visual taste and storytelling ability who can understand what I've established and suggest ways to make it better.



This isn't a role where I'm looking simply for someone who knows how to operate editing software. Editorial judgement, storytelling, pacing and taste are important to me.



What I'll Provide



For the first project, I'll provide:

- Organised raw footage

- Voiceover/dialogue

- A reference script/edit structure showing the intended story, voiceover and key moments

- Approved English and Chinese subtitle copy

- The finished Part 1 as the main style reference

- Previous content for additional reference

- Fonts and existing graphics/assets where relevant

- Notes on important moments



The reference script should be treated as a starting point rather than something that has to be followed rigidly.

If you think the story, structure, pacing or presentation could be improved, I actively welcome your suggestions.



What I'm Looking For



I'm particularly interested in editors who are strong at:

- Storytelling and pacing

- Food, travel, documentary or lifestyle content

- Selecting strong B-roll and knowing when to let shots breathe

- Music and sound design

- Clean, considered graphics and typography

- Basic colour grading and audio finishing

- Short-form editing without excessive jump cuts, emojis or generic social-media effects

- Working from an established visual style while bringing your own ideas to it



You can edit in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut or another professional NLE. I currently edit my own content in CapCut, so you do not need to use the same software.



Future Work



This first video is intended as a paid test project for a longer-term relationship.



I'm currently producing short documentaries about Chinese food and restaurants in the UK. I've already filmed two in Sheffield; I'll edit the first myself to establish the style, and I'm looking for an editor to take on the second.



I'll also be filming food and culture content in China and elsewhere in Asia.



Longer term, I'd like to find an editor who can take organised raw footage, interviews and a story brief and develop an edit with increasing independence — not someone who needs every cut specified for them.



First Project Deliverables



For the Hotpot Cocktail Part 2 video:



- Approximately 2–3 minute vertical (9:16) edit

- Bilingual English/Chinese subtitles using supplied copy

- Music and sound design

- Graphics consistent with Part 1

- Basic colour and audio finishing

- Two reasonable rounds of revisions

- Final high-quality master

- Clean version without subtitles

- Project/source files and any custom assets created



How to Apply



Please answer all four questions below. Generic applications that don't address these questions will not be considered.



1. Please share ONE video you've edited that you think is most relevant to this project.

Briefly explain why you chose it and what your role was in the edit.



2. Please watch the Part 1 reference video linked above.

What is one element of the editing/style you would keep for Part 2, and one thing you would consider changing or improving?



3. Based on the project description and reference video, approximately how many hours would you expect the first 2–3 minute video to take, including two reasonable rounds of revisions?

Please briefly explain your estimate.



4. I'll provide a reference script/edit structure, but I welcome creative input rather than expecting it to be followed rigidly.

How would you approach suggesting changes if you thought the story, pacing or structure could be improved?

Please also include your hourly rate and your usual availability/turnaround time.



I'm much more interested in seeing one genuinely relevant piece of work and understanding how you think as an editor than receiving a long showreel or list of portfolio links.

4+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience, ideally agency-side across multiple accounts

Genuine experience in both ecommerce and lead generation (not just one)

Strong grasp of conversion tracking: GA4, GTM, enhanced conversions, offline imports

Comfortable in Google Ads Editor, Merchant Center and spreadsheets

Someone who thinks in terms of profit and business outcomes, not platform metrics

Self-directed: you can be handed an account and a goal and get on with it

Available for some overlap with Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT)



Nice to have



Meta Ads experience

Feed management tools (Channable, Feedonomics or similar)

Looker Studio reporting

Shopify familiarity — comfortable navigating a store, collections and product pages

SEO fundamentals: you understand how paid and organic interact, and can spot when a landing page is working against itself

title: SEO Outreach & Link Building Specialist — Acquire Online Communities
description:
IF YOU'VE DONE LINK BUILDING OUTREACH, THIS IS YOUR JOB — JUST A BIGGER PRIZE

You already know the loop: prospect sites in Ahrefs, check the traffic and niche, find the owner, reach out cold, negotiate a price, close the placement. We do the exact same thing — except instead of buying a guest post or a backlink, you're acquiring the whole community. Same skills, same tools, higher-value deals.



WHO WE ARE

We're a small digital media company that grows and manages niche online communities in the wedding and lifestyle space. We're hiring an experienced SEO outreach / link builder to source and acquire communities for us. You bring the Ahrefs judgment and the outreach muscle; we'll teach you the platform side (Reddit) fast.



THE JOB, DAY TO DAY

• Prospect and vet communities from a list our software pulls — the same way you'd vet a site for a link: traffic, niche relevance, keyword and search intent, real engagement vs. inflated numbers

• Judge commercial value — does this niche have buyer-intent keywords and monetization potential, or does it just look big?

• Find the owner/moderator and reach out across the right channels (their public socials, DMs) — cold outreach you've done a thousand times

• Negotiate the price and close the acquisition — moderation rights or full ownership transfer

• Coordinate the handoff once terms are set

• Keep a clean pipeline: prospects, outreach status, deals, spend



WHAT WE'RE ACTUALLY HIRING FOR

1. Ahrefs-level judgment. Anyone can read a traffic number. You can look at a site or community and tell whether the niche is worth paying for — search intent, commercial keywords, traffic quality. This is the rare skill, and it's the one link builders already have.

2. Outreach and negotiation. Cold-contacting an owner, getting a reply, agreeing on a price, and closing. If you've negotiated guest post or link placements, you've done this — we just need you comfortable doing it on bigger deals.



Reddit experience is a plus, not a requirement. The platform mechanics are quick to learn for someone who already knows SEO.



WHO YOU PROBABLY ARE

• An experienced link builder, SEO outreach specialist, guest post / blogger outreach VA, or digital PR outreach person with real past work you can point to

• Fluent in Ahrefs (or Semrush) — prospecting, traffic analysis, keyword and niche evaluation

• Comfortable with high-volume cold outreach AND with negotiating a price with a site owner

• You understand niches, search intent, and what makes traffic actually valuable

• Organized, self-directed, runs your own pipeline

• Clear written English

• Bonus: affiliate marketing experience, or you've bought/sold websites or domains



COMPENSATION

Competitive base + a bonus on every acquisition you close. Strong closers earn well here.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE

1. Describe your link building / outreach experience — what kinds of sites did you prospect, what tools did you use, and roughly what volume of outreach and placements did you handle?

2. You're evaluating a site or community in Ahrefs. Beyond the raw traffic number, what specifically tells you the niche is genuinely valuable and worth paying for versus something that just looks big? Be specific.

3. Tell me about a placement or deal where the owner wasn't interested at first. How did you get them to a yes, and how did you handle the price?

4. Your desired rate and weekly availability.

title: Residential Construction Estimator
description:
We are a small construction company (a team of 5 people)  based in Western Southland, New Zealand. 



We complete new residential builds, renovations, rural pole sheds, re-roofing, cladding and other residential and rural projects throughout Southland and Fiordland.



We are looking for someone to join the team, that is able to accurately price jobs using architectural plans and complete back-costing reports on existing jobs.



About the Role

We are looking for a someone to:



* Price residential and rural construction projects.

* Prepare detailed material take-offs.

* Develop labour allowances.

* Create construction programmes.

* Prepare material-ordering schedules.



Engagement and Payment

* Approved work will be paid weekly through Wise or PayPal.

* The role will begin with a paid test project.

* Initial 90-day trial.



Systems and Access

Singh Building will provide:



* A company Google account.

* Access to Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs and Google Sheets.

* Access to Wunderbuild, which is our estimating software.



The successful applicant must complete the required Wunderbuild training before starting a live estimate. Training time will be paid.



All Singh Building work must be completed and stored using the company accounts provided.



Required Experience

Applicants must have a background in quantity surveying, construction estimating, architecture, engineering, project management or practical construction.



You must be able to:

* Read architectural and engineering drawings.

* Complete detailed quantity take-offs.

* Prepare labour and material cost build-ups.

* Create practical construction programmes.

* Use spreadsheets confidently.

* Explain assumptions and ask clear questions.

* Communicate clearly in written and spoken English.

* Use Wunderbuild, Buildxact or similar estimating software.



New Zealand or Australian estimating experience is preferred, but we are willing to train someone with strong construction knowledge and the right attitude.





New Zealand Construction Knowledge

The successful applicant must become familiar with the New Zealand Building Code and relevant Southland District Council consent guidance.



You are not expected to approve Building Code compliance. However, you must understand the New Zealand construction environment well enough to identify requirements or missing information that could affect the estimate, take-off or programme.



If something is unclear, it must be raised with Singh Building rather than assumed.



Key Responsibilities



Review Project Information

Before beginning an estimate:

* Review the drawings, specifications, engineering information and site details.

* Confirm the document dates and drawing revisions.

* Identify missing or conflicting information.

* Prepare a clear list of questions and assumptions.

* Agree on the required deliverables and completion date.



Prepare Estimates

Prepare detailed estimates in Wunderbuild covering all relevant project costs, including:

* Materials and wastage.

* Labour by construction stage.

* Subcontractors.

* Plant, equipment and scaffolding.

* Freight, travel and accommodation where applicable.

* Site establishment and project overheads.

* Prime-cost items, provisional sums and approved mark-ups.



Supplier and subcontractor prices must show their source and date. Any figure that is not based on a confirmed price must be clearly identified as an allowance.



Complete Material Take-Offs

Prepare accurate, traceable take-offs for the materials required to complete each project.

Take-offs must:

* Use metric measurements.

* Identify the relevant drawing and revision.

* Separate different products, sizes and specifications.

* Show wastage and provisional quantities.

* Be checked before submission.

* Be detailed enough for Singh Building to obtain supplier prices and order materials.



Take-offs may cover concrete, reinforcing, framing, structural timber, roofing, cladding, insulation, linings, flooring, windows, doors, fixings, trim, decking, rural shed materials and other project-specific items.



Prepare Labour Allowances

* Break labour into practical construction stages.

* Use Singh Building’s approved labour rates and productivity assumptions.

* Identify the number and type of workers allowed for.

* Account for site access, travel, setup and weather where relevant.

* Highlight labour-intensive stages and areas of uncertainty.



Create Construction Programmes

Prepare a practical construction programme for each project, including:

* Construction stages and realistic durations.

* Dependencies between builders, subcontractors and suppliers.

* Council inspections.

* Material lead times and ordering dates.

* Customer selections and decision deadlines.

* Work that can occur at the same time.

* Likely delays, clashes or risks.



The programme must reflect how the project will actually be built and must not rely only on generic software durations.



Where ongoing scheduling is included in the agreed project scope, you will update the programme using information from the site team and clearly identify any changes or risks to key dates.



Prepare Material-Ordering Information

Provide material-ordering information showing:

* Product or specification.

* Size and quantity.

* Wastage allowed.

* Required-on-site date.

* Construction stage.

* Supplier or price source.

* Lead time.

* Drawing reference.

* Outstanding decisions.



The estimator will prepare ordering information but must not place orders without Singh Building’s approval.



Final Deliverables

Each completed project estimate must include (all done within Wunderbuild):

* Detailed estimate.

* Quantity take-off.

* Labour build-up.

* Supplier and subcontractor pricing.

* Construction programme.

* Material-ordering schedule.

* Assumptions and exclusions.

* Prime-cost items and provisional sums.

* Identified risks and outstanding questions.

* Drawing revision, estimate version and date.

* Supporting calculations and source files.



You must be available to explain the estimate and complete agreed revisions following our review.



Final pricing and customer quotations remain subject to Singh Building’s approval.



What Success Looks Like After 90 Days

By the end of the first 90 days:

* Required training is completed during the first week.

* Missing information is identified before detailed estimating begins.

* At least 95% of agreed deadlines are met.

* Any risk to a deadline is raised in advance.

* Estimates are complete, checked and traceable.

* Quantities can be traced to the correct drawing or specification.

* Unconfirmed costs are clearly labelled as allowances.

* Take-offs are suitable for supplier pricing and material ordering.

* Construction programmes include inspections, dependencies, lead times and customer decisions.

* Schedule risks are raised as soon as they become known.

* Timesheets are submitted weekly in 30-minute increments.

* Work remains within the approved allowance unless additional time has been approved.

* At least one practical improvement to our estimating or scheduling process has been suggested.



How to Apply

Please provide:

* Your CV and relevant qualifications.

* Your proposed rate or pricing structure.

* Your availability.

* Details of your estimating and construction experience.

* Experience with Wunderbuild, Buildxact or similar software.

* Examples of previous estimates or take-offs with confidential information removed.

* A short video submission.



In your two-to-four-minute video, please tell us:

1. About your construction and estimating experience if any.

2. What types of projects you have priced.

3. How you make sure a take-off is complete.

4. What you would do if the drawings and specification conflicted.

5. How you would create a realistic construction programme.



Please speak naturally rather than reading a prepared script. We use the video to assess how clearly and confidently you communicate in English.

• After successfully completing probation: full-time, 40 hours per week.

• Workdays: Monday–Friday during U.S. business hours.

• During probation: 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Los Angeles time.

• The full-time shift will be agreed before the transition.



COMPENSATION



• $8 USD per hour during probation and after.

• Weekly hourly payments through Wise.

• $5 bonus for every verified new business registration generated by the callers you supervise, including during probation.



Each business counts once. Registrations must belong to real businesses with valid contact details and be attributed to your team in our CRM. Duplicate, test, or fabricated accounts do not qualify. A customer deposit is not required for the registration bonus.



All recruiting, training, management, reporting, and personal calling tasks are included in paid working hours.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Recruit and screen cold callers: review applications, conduct interviews, assess English, and run role-play exercises.

• Keep two caller positions staffed and maintain a shortlist of suitable replacement candidates.

• Recommend hires and replacements to the owner for final approval.

• Onboard employees using our scripts, Quo calling software, and Google Sheets.

• Assign company lists, coordinate shifts, and prevent duplicate outreach.

• Monitor attendance, calling activity, follow-ups, and CRM accuracy.

• Review call recordings, give practical feedback, and help callers improve.

• Regularly improve scripts based on actual objections and results.

• Use AI tools to support call analysis while checking their conclusions.

• Make outbound calls personally and cover calling gaps when needed.

• Send the owner a short daily written report.



OUR CALLING GOAL



Reach the owner or person responsible for acquiring new customers, obtain their
 or SMS contact, and get permission to send information about Handy Alliance.



Help the team follow up and track progress from initial conversations to interested businesses and website registrations. All pricing and commercial promises must follow the owner’s approved terms.



REQUIREMENTS



• At least two years of cold-calling or B2B sales experience.

• Experience supervising or coaching callers.

• Practical recruiting and interviewing experience.

• Clear spoken English and strong written communication.

• Familiarity with Google Sheets, CRM systems, and call recordings.

• Quo/OpenPhone experience is a plus.

• Reliable computer, headset, internet, and a backup plan for outages.

• Ability to work independently and communicate with the owner primarily in writing.

• Availability for 20 hours per week during probation and 40 hours per week afterward.



WE PROVIDE



Calling software, business contact lists, initial scripts, service information, working spreadsheets, and direct support from the owner.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with: TEAM LEAD



Please send:



1. Your calling, recruiting, and team leadership experience, including team size.

2. One example of how you improved a caller’s performance, with results and the time period.

3. A 60–90 second recording of your own voice speaking English.

4. Your plan for recruiting and supporting two reliable callers.

5. Confirmation that you accept the pay and can work 20 hours per week during probation, then 40 hours per week.

6. Your earliest available start date.

title: Technical Support Representative – U.S. Company
description:
Technical Support Representative – U.S. Company



Full-Time | U.S. Business Hours | Remote | Bacolod Area Preferred



About Buzztime

Buzztime is a U.S.-based technology company providing interactive entertainment systems to bars and restaurants throughout the United States and Canada. Our platform brings games such as Network Trivia, hosted Live Trivia, Poker, Bingo, Fantasy Sports, music trivia, and more to hospitality venues.



Our current Buzztime Game Network (BGN) platform combines Google ChromeOS, ASUS Chromebox 5a hardware, Lenovo Android tablets, cloud-based software, Wi-Fi/networking, and TV/audio-video equipment.



We're looking for a talented Technical Support Representative who genuinely enjoys solving technical problems and helping people.



What You'll Do

You'll work directly with bar and restaurant owners, managers, and staff to troubleshoot their Buzztime systems remotely.



The issues you'll encounter are varied, so we're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out rather than simply following a script.



You'll help customers troubleshoot:

- Internet, Wi-Fi, and basic networking issues

- Google ChromeOS and ASUS Chromebox hardware

- Android tablets and mobile devices

- TV connections and audio/video issues

- HDMI, cabling, and other AV connections

- Buzztime software and cloud services

- System setup, configuration, and general technical questions



Most of our customers are non-technical business users, so strong communication skills are just as important as technical knowledge. You should be able to take a technical problem and turn the solution into clear, simple instructions that anyone can follow.



Who We're Looking For



We're especially interested in someone who:

- Has hands-on technical support or troubleshooting experience

- Has experience helping non-technical business customers

- Understands Internet, Wi-Fi, and basic networking

- Is comfortable troubleshooting TVs, audio/video connections, HDMI, and related equipment

- Has experience with Android phones or tablets

- Is comfortable learning new hardware and software

- Communicates clearly in spoken and written English

- Takes ownership of problems instead of simply passing them along

- Is dependable, organized, patient, and resourceful

- Can work independently and knows when an issue needs to be escalated



Most importantly, we want someone who loves helping people with technology and wants to impress our customers with great support.



We're not looking for someone who simply wants to close as many tickets as possible. We're looking for someone who wants to understand the problem, own it, and get the customer back up and running.



Working Hours & Location

- Working during U.S. business hours is required.

- This is a remote position, but being located in or around Bacolod City would be a strong advantage.



Why This Role Is Interesting



- This isn't repetitive password-reset support.

- You'll work with a real combination of hardware, software, Android devices, ChromeOS, networking, Wi-Fi, TVs, and AV equipment installed in operating bars and restaurants across the U.S. and Canada.

- You'll have the opportunity to learn the entire Buzztime technology ecosystem and become a trusted part of a small team where strong performers can make a noticeable impact.



If you're the type of person who enjoys hearing “it's not working”, figuring out why, fixing it, and leaving the customer impressed with the support they received, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Accounts Assistant – AP/AR & Bookkeeping
description:
Accounts Assistant – AP/AR & Bookkeeping

Remote, Philippines | US$300 per week | Full-time | European business hours



Enjoy keeping invoices organised, matching payments and finding the reason numbers don’t balance?



Adminworks is hiring an Accounts Assistant to support the European finance team of an established international fashion and denim business.



You’ll work directly with the European Finance Manager, helping keep everyday bookkeeping accurate, organised and up to date. This is a practical role for someone who enjoys accounts payable, accounts receivable and reconciliation work, and wants to build experience within an international business.



The Opportunity:

Pay: US$300 per week.

Arrangement: Full-time remote contractor engagement, 40 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, aligned with the team’s business hours in Stockholm. This involves afternoon/evening work in the Philippines and may extend past midnight; the exact schedule will be agreed during screening and will follow European daylight-saving changes.

Start: As soon as practical. Please include your earliest start date and any notice period.



What you’ll do

- Your initial focus will be the recurring accounts work that supports the Finance Manager:

- Enter and code supplier invoices, check supporting documents and follow up missing information.

- Match customer receipts to invoices and investigate unmatched payments.

- Prepare payment schedules and supporting records for approval.

- Reconcile bank and payment-platform transactions, flagging differences for review.

- Keep expense receipts, company-card records and finance spreadsheets organised.

- Monitor shared finance inboxes and respond to routine supplier and customer queries.

- Follow up overdue invoices professionally by
 and, where needed, phone.

- Prepare customer and agent statements using existing templates.

- Support month-end preparation with reconciliations, schedules and supporting documents.



The business operates across multiple currencies and uses Garp ERP, which involves manual transaction entry. You’ll learn the company’s systems and workflows with the Finance Manager, taking responsibility for agreed tasks as you become confident.



Tax submissions, complex accounting decisions and final approvals remain with the Finance Manager or appointed accountant.



What we’re looking for

- You’ll likely have around 2–4 years of relevant accounts or bookkeeping experience, with practical ability in three areas:

- Everyday bookkeeping: Supplier invoices, customer receipts, basic coding and bank reconciliations. You can spot a discrepancy and explain how you would investigate it.

- Spreadsheets and accounting systems: Comfortable matching lists in Excel using VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP or similar functions, and experienced with an accounting package or ERP.

- Communication and follow-through: Clear spoken and written English, confidence following up queries, and the judgement to ask questions when something needs review.

- You should also have a reliable remote-work setup and be able to work the agreed European schedule consistently.

- Experience with foreign-currency transactions, Shopify, PayPal or international customers would be useful. Previous Garp experience, Swedish language skills and a CPA qualification are not required.



Why join?



You’ll work closely with a Finance Manager, contribute to the everyday running of established international fashion brands, and develop your experience with European finance processes and multiple currencies.



We value reliable follow-through, careful work and people who raise issues early.



How to apply

- Apply with your CV and brief answers to these questions:

- Which accounts payable, receivable and reconciliation tasks have you personally handled?

- Which accounting systems and Excel functions have you used?

- Describe a reconciliation difference you found and how you resolved it.

- Can you work 40 hours per week aligned with Stockholm business hours at US$300 per week?

- What is your earliest available start date?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a brief practical bookkeeping exercise and meet the team.



Applications are being reviewed now.

title: Finance & Marketing Coordinator
description:
You have successfully maintained the books and accounting for an Australian business turning over $5 million or more and are now looking for a broader role where you can take on greater responsibility and contribute beyond finance in a key position.



Reporting to the Australian management team, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration. You'll maintain accurate financial records, complete reconciliations, manage accounts payable and receivable, and prepare timely financial information and management reports. You'll also work alongside our external accountant, who manages the BAS and taxation requirements.



Beyond the accounting responsibilities, you'll enjoy a varied role supporting the business in other key areas. This includes coordinating marketing activities with our Australian team to grow Yum Tasmanian’s online presence, assisting with grant applications, and contributing to a range of business initiatives.



Yum Tasmanian is a proudly Australian, family-owned business that has been supplying premium potatoes throughout Australia for more than 30 years. Beginning as an organic potato producer in 1994, the business has grown into a nationally recognised supplier to major retailers including Coles, Woolworths, IGA, independent retailers and wholesale markets.



Today, the group operates across several businesses within agriculture, fresh produce and related industries. As the business continues to grow, there is a strong focus on building the Yum brand, educating consumers and expanding its online presence through organic marketing.



We want you to be a driver in helping us build Yum into Australia's most recognised online potato brand by growing our organic digital presence to over 1 million Instagram and
 followers through organic marketing.



The role is Monday to Friday, working from an office. In return for your great performance, you’ll be supported with autonomy, rewards and more opportunity for growth over time.



If this sounds like a role you’d enjoy and succeed in, apply now via the link below for more information.

- Draft diverse assets: Work on furniture, plumbing fixtures, lighting, electrical, structural, and more.

- Collaborate efficiently: Manage your workflow using Asana, Google Sheets, and shared QA checklists.

- Professional Organization: Ability to structure and name parameters cleanly and logically.

- Work Ethic: Strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and comfortable with English documentation.

100% Remote: Work from home with flexible hours.

title: Shopify Store Builder for FASHION & JEWELRY Dropshipping
description:

For each store, you will receive:



A Shopify theme/template to work from

A reference website showing the style, layout, and structure we want

Branding, product images, and other assets

A clear brief explaining the brand, target audience, offer, and storytelling/positioning



Your role will be to turn these materials into a complete, polished Shopify store that closely follows the reference website while adapting it to the new brand and products.



Typical tasks:



Building fashion/jewelry Shopify stores

Recreating layouts and sections from reference websites

Adding provided copy, imagery, branding, and storytelling

Setting up homepage, product pages, collections, menus, and navigation

**What this role is**



This is not a "send a newsletter every week" role. Our Klaviyo account has been dormant since 2024, and we need someone to rebuild it properly from the ground up and then run it.



Phase 1 is a rebuild project (roughly 4–6 weeks). Phase 2 is ongoing management of the channel. We are hiring one person for both.



**Phase 1 — Account rebuild**



- Audit the existing Klaviyo account: old flows, forms, lists, and segments. Recommend what to keep, fix, or delete.

- Re-enable and verify the Shopify integration, confirm order history and Placed Order events are syncing correctly.

- Clean and segment the contact list. A portion of our contacts were manually imported from Etsy and have no purchase events attached — these need to be identified and handled separately.

- Verify and repair sending infrastructure: dedicated sending domain, DKIM, SPF, and DMARC.

- Plan and execute a re-engagement and warm-up sequence so we can start sending to a two-year-dormant list without damaging our domain reputation. This is the single most important part of the job.

- Build our core flow suite: welcome series, abandoned cart, abandoned checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, and win-back. Abandoned cart is our first priority.

- Build on-site signup forms and a popup that matches our brand.



**Phase 2 — Ongoing management**



- Plan and send a monthly campaign calendar (promotions, new product launches, seasonal).

- Write
 copy and build
s in Klaviyo's editor using our product photography.

- Maintain segmentation and suppression lists; monitor list health.

- A/B test subject lines, send times, and offers.

- Report monthly on flow revenue, campaign revenue, open/click/conversion rates, deliverability, and list growth.



---



## REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



- Minimum 2 years of hands-on Klaviyo experience with Shopify e-commerce brands. This is a hard requirement — please do not apply if your experience is mainly Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, or general VA work.

- Proven experience with
 deliverability: sending domain setup, DKIM/SPF/DMARC, sender reputation repair, and list warming.

s that look good on mobile, working from existing brand photography.

- Basic HTML/CSS for

Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder.



This is not a sourcing-team or coordinator seat. You take the list of open US jobs, build the fill strategy for each one (sourcing channels, candidate pool, pay-band reality, timeline), personally recruit on the priority searches — sourcing, screening, and submitting candidates yourself — and build and coach a small delivery team as volume grows. You own the number: qualified submittals per week and jobs filled.



Responsibilities

- Own the open-req board: triage every US job, build a written per-req fill strategy, and keep every req moving or call it honestly.

- Personally work the priority desks full-cycle: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit qualified candidates to US clients.

- Drive the delivery standard — quality-gated submittals per recruiter per week — with every candidate recruiter-screened before submission, no resume-blasting.

- Recruit, onboard, and coach delivery recruiters as the board requires; run the daily delivery cadence and report fill metrics weekly to the founder.

- Tell the truth with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



Required

- 4+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, including 2+ years leading a delivery team that was measured on submittals and placements (not a sourcing-only or admin team). US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

- Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements you made (role, US state, salary) and walk through how you filled them. There WILL be a detailed walkthrough on the interview.

- Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

- Excellent spoken English — you screen candidates by phone and coach people who do; there will be a live spoken check.

- Fluent with an ATS and modern sourcing (job boards, LinkedIn, licensure/credential basics for US healthcare roles).

- Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



**Do NOT apply if:** your leadership experience is sourcing/CV-mining teams only (you've never owned submittals-to-fill); you've only coordinated VMS portals or onboarding paperwork; you cannot name specific placements you personally closed; your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US healthcare professionals; or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.

title: Operations & Growth Virtual Assistant — Photo Booth/Event Company
description:
# Operations & Growth Virtual Assistant

**Remote | Part-Time | 8–10 Hours/Week | Long-Term**



ProSnap Booth is an Atlanta-based photo booth and event experience company serving weddings, corporate events, schools and private events.



We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage the behind-the-scenes operations of the business.



This is not a basic data-entry position. We're looking for someone who can learn our systems, stay on top of multiple moving pieces, communicate professionally with clients and business partners, and identify things that need attention before they become problems.



## Your Core Responsibilities



### Event & Client Operations

- Review upcoming booked events and make sure required information is being completed on time.

- Monitor client payments, design submissions, questionnaires and other event requirements.

- Follow up with clients when information or action is missing.

- Maintain accurate client notes, tasks and event information.

- Identify upcoming events that may have missing information, staffing issues, overdue designs, payment issues or other potential problems.

- Bring issues to the owner before they become urgent.

- Help maintain our event readiness/checklist process.



### CRM & Lead Management

- Work daily inside GoHighLevel.

- Maintain contacts, opportunities, tasks, tags and notes.

- Add new prospects to the appropriate sales/relationship-development pipeline.

- Move opportunities through the correct pipeline stages.

- Complete scheduled follow-up tasks.

- Keep CRM records organized and accurate.

- Identify opportunities that need owner involvement.



### Venue & Partnership Outreach

- Research wedding venues and other potential referral partners.

- Send personalized Instagram and/or
 outreach.

- Complete scheduled follow-ups.

- Monitor incoming responses.

- Distinguish genuine human responses from automated replies.

- Maintain conversations professionally without sounding scripted or spammy.

- Ask appropriate qualification questions.

- Determine whether a venue has a preferred-vendor list or partnership opportunities.

- Keep qualified prospects moving toward a phone conversation, meeting or venue walkthrough with the owner.

- Escalate strong opportunities when the owner should personally step into the conversation.



###
 & Communication Monitoring

- Monitor the company inbox for actionable messages.

- Identify leads, client questions, venue responses and open conversations requiring attention.

- Follow up when appropriate.

- Draft responses for owner review when necessary.

- Make sure important conversations do not sit unanswered.

- Surface anything urgent or financially important.



### Social Media Support

- Select strong images/content from completed photo booth events.

- Organize marketing assets.

- Schedule Instagram/social posts through GoHighLevel.

- Submit posts for approval.

- Maintain the weekly posting schedule.

- Follow established branding/content guidelines.



### Weekly Operations Review

- Prepare for a weekly planning meeting with the owner.

- Review upcoming events, leads, outstanding client actions, pipeline activity and important follow-ups before the meeting.

- Be prepared to explain what is complete, what is waiting, what is overdue and what requires the owner's attention.

- Capture new action items and ensure they are followed through afterward.



## Systems You'll Work With



Experience with every system is not required, but you must be comfortable learning software quickly.



Primary tools include:



- GoHighLevel

- Gmail

- Google Calendar

- TickTick

- Instagram / Meta

- Google Drive

- BoothBook or similar booking/event-management software

- ChatGPT/AI tools



**GoHighLevel experience is highly preferred.**



## The Person We're Looking For



You should be:



- Extremely organized and detail-oriented.

- Dependable and consistent.

- Comfortable working independently.

- A strong written English communicator.

- Able to communicate naturally rather than sounding like a template.

- Proactive — you notice problems instead of waiting to be told about them.

- Comfortable following SOPs while still using good judgment.

- Able to manage several small responsibilities without losing track of them.

- Comfortable communicating with wedding venues, clients and business professionals.

- Able to recognize when you can handle something yourself and when the owner needs to step in.

- Tech-savvy and willing to troubleshoot before immediately asking for help.

- Comfortable using AI such as ChatGPT to research, draft and problem-solve.

- Interested in a long-term role and growing with a small business.



## Schedule



Approximately **8–10 hours per week to start**.



We strongly prefer someone who can provide some availability **Monday through Friday during U.S. Eastern Time business hours** rather than completing all hours on one or two days.



There will also be one recurring weekly planning meeting.



Additional hours may become available as the business grows.



## Compensation



Target starting range:



**$6–$7 USD/hour depending on experience and skill level.**



Long-term growth and additional responsibility are available for the right person.



## Success in This Role Looks Like



After training, the owner should not have to constantly ask:



- Did that client respond?

- Did they make their payment?

- Did they submit their design information?

- Did we follow up with that venue?

- Did anyone reply to our outreach?

- Is something being forgotten for next weekend?

- Did that
 ever get answered?



Your job is to help create confidence that the operational details of the business are being watched and handled.



## To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your location and time zone.

3. Your desired hourly rate.

4. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time.

5. Your experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM.

6. Your experience managing
, client follow-up, pipelines, social media or business operations.

7. An example of a situation where you noticed a problem and solved it without being asked.

8. A 60–90 second video introduction.



In your application, also answer this question:



**If you noticed that an event was seven days away, the client's final payment was complete, but their design information had still not been submitted, what would you do?**

, TikTok, X

title: Sales Representative - (Text Based, No Calls)
description:
This is a sales role, not customer support.



CartForce helps US wellness brands turn “almost customers” into buyers by texting people who added products to their cart but didn’t finish buying.



Think products like saunas, ice baths, red light therapy, and recovery tools.



Your job is to read the conversation, understand where the customer is stuck, and write the reply that moves them closer to purchasing.



The replies you write directly affect client revenue, so we care a lot about judgment, speed, and quality.



---

REQUIREMENTS



- Strong written English

- Comfortable working US hours

- Reliable internet and laptop

- Fast response speed during shift

- Experience with US customers preferred

- Prior sales experience where you were responsible for outcomes, not just replies



We do not want copy-paste support replies. You need to think, read the situation, and choose the right next move.



---

WHAT YOU GET



You’ll get daily feedback on real conversations so you can improve fast. We’ll show you what worked, what missed, and why.



Most remote reps never get trained this closely. If you’re good, this is a role where your skill can compound. As CartForce grows, top performers will earn more and get more responsibility.



---

HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send a message with:



1. CartForceX(yourname)

2. A loom or voice recording talking about your sales experience and why you think you would be great in this role

3. Optional: Anything else you think would make your application stand out



We’ll review applications and reach out soon with next steps if it looks like a strong fit.

title: Acquisitions Specialist – Real Estate Acquisition Deal Making Experience Welcome
description:
IF YOU'VE DONE REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS, WHOLESALING, OR DEAL-CLOSING — READ THIS

This is the same work you already do, just a different asset. If you've sourced off-market properties, cold-called owners who weren't listed, negotiated a price, and closed the transfer — you have exactly the skill set we need. Swap "distressed property" for "online community" and the job is identical: find the owner, figure out what it's worth, reach out, and close.



WHO WE ARE

We're a small digital media company that grows and manages niche online communities. We're hiring a sharp closer to acquire them for us. The assets are Reddit communities — but we'll teach you the platform mechanics. What we can't teach is deal instinct and judgment, and that's what we're actually hiring for.



THE JOB, DAY TO DAY

• Start from a list of candidate communities our software pulls for you, and d
 which are worth going after

• Size up each one's real worth — the right niche, genuine demand, real commercial upside — not just the headline numbers

• Track down the owner and reach them across the right channels (often their public social profiles) to open a conversation

• Negotiate and close the deal — either moderation rights or a full ownership transfer

• Coordinate the handoff once terms are agreed

• Keep a tidy pipeline of targets, conversations, deals, and spend



WHAT MATTERS MOST (in this order)

1. Judgment — anyone can read a traffic stat. The rare skill is knowing whether a community is actually worth paying for, and how much, without us in the room for every call.

2. Closing — cold-reaching a stranger, warming them up, negotiating, and getting the deal done. This is the bulk of the work.



Reddit experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement — the platform side is quick to pick up. If you're a strong closer who's never touched Reddit, still apply.



WHO YOU LIKELY ARE

• A real estate acquisitions / disposition VA, wholesaler, cold caller, domain or website flipper, or anyone who sources and closes deals for a living

• You can size up an asset's value fast and be right

• You're comfortable reaching out to strangers and closing them

• You run your own pipeline with little oversight

• Clear written English

• Nice-to-have: Reddit, affiliate, or SEO background



COMPENSATION

Competitive base + a bonus on every deal you close. Strong closers earn well here.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE

1. Walk me through one deal you sourced and closed yourself — a property, domain, website, whatever. How'd you find it, how'd you d
 what it was worth, and how'd you close it?

2. When you size up an online asset, what actually tells you it's worth paying for versus something that just looks big? Be specific.

3. You need to acquire something from an owner who isn't trying to sell. How do you reach them and open the negotiation?

4. Your desired rate or salary.

Full-time · Remote · Dedicated seat through ROI Online

You are the hands and quality-control layer on an AI-driven marketing engine: tools draft, you edit, publish, format, QA, and ship. We are a fast-paced, systems-driven dental organization focused on building something bigger than just dental offices. We create opportunities for people, develop leaders, and are committed to delivering the most comfortable dental experience possible.



As our organization continues to expand, we are looking for a highly capable, detail-oriented, and analytical Virtual Business Analyst to support our leadership team across multiple dental offices.



This is not a basic data-entry role. This role is for someone who loves numbers, understands how businesses operate, catches discrepancies, and turns information into clear, actionable insights that help leadership make better decisions.



###What You’ll Do



You will support key financial, operational, and leadership functions across Pure Dental Spa and Chicago Dental Specialists, including:



**Payroll & Financial Support**



* Process payroll accurately and on schedule, including reviewing hours, attendance, and payroll-related information.



* Identify discrepancies and coordinate with the appropriate team members to resolve them.



* Maintain organized payroll records and confidential employee information.



* Assist with financial reports, expense tracking, and other administrative financial tasks.



**Business Metrics & Reporting**



* Pull and organize daily, weekly, and monthly business metrics from our systems.



* Maintain KPI dashboards and leadership scorecards.



* Track production, revenue, collections, scheduling, and other operational performance metrics.



* Identify trends, inconsistencies, and areas that require leadership attention.



* Prepare clear reports and summaries that help leadership understand business performance.



**Leadership & Operations Support**



* Support the CEO and leadership team with reports, projects, and operational follow-up.



* Track deadlines, action items, and accountability across departments.



* Assist with SOPs, checklists, workflows, and process improvements.



* Organize information and help ensure leadership has accurate data when needed.



* Research business solutions and assist with special projects.



### Who You Are



* Highly analytical and exceptionally detail-oriented.



* Strong with spreadsheets, formulas, and organizing large amounts of data.



* Comfortable working with numbers and identifying errors.



* Able to handle confidential payroll and business information with professionalism.



* Proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently.



* Strong written and verbal English communication.



* Organized and comfortable managing multiple deadlines.



* Able to explain data clearly to non-technical team members.



* Tech-savvy and quick to learn new systems.



* Comfortable in a fast-moving, growing organization.



### Bonus Points If You Have



* Experience processing payroll or supporting finance/HR operations.



* Experience as a Business Analyst, Operations Analyst, Financial Analyst, or similar role.



* Experience in healthcare, dental, or multi-location businesses.



* Familiarity with dental practice management software, KPI dashboards, or reporting tools.



* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.



* Experience with Google Workspace, task management tools, and AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.



* Experience supporting CEOs, founders, or executive leadership teams.



### Work Schedule



**Part-Time Remote — Philippines**



Must be available to overlap with **U.S. Central Time business hours**.



### Compensation



Competitive and based on experience.



### Why Join Us



At Pure Dental Spa, businesses don’t grow — people do.



This is an opportunity to become a key part of a growing organization where your work directly supports business decisions, operational improvement, and leadership success. If you enjoy working with numbers, building systems, and helping a business operate at a higher level, we want to meet you.



### To Apply



Please send your resume and a short video introduction (2–3 minutes) telling us about your experience with payroll, business reporting, and supporting leadership teams. We’d also love to hear about a time you identified a discrepancy or used data to improve a process.



If you love numbers, systems, and helping leaders make better decisions — apply now!

title: Executive Assistant & International Business Projects Coordinator
description:
Remote | 90-Day Contract-to-Hire | International Business / Africa / DRC



Compensation: $1,000–$1,300 USD per month, depending on experience

Initial Term: Paid 90-day contract with opportunity for a long-term position



We are seeking a highly capable Executive Assistant & International Business Projects Coordinator to work directly with the founder on international business ventures involving the United States, Africa, and the Democratic Republic of Congo.

This is not a traditional virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who combines strong executive support skills with business judgment, legal/ document experience, research ability, project management, and intelligent use of ChatGPT and other AI tools.



The successful candidate will support two primary initiatives:

1. International Industrial & Commodity Supply Business

Supporting the development of an international sulfuric acid supply business serving industrial and mining customers in the Democratic Republic of Congo and surrounding African markets.



Responsibilities may include:

Researching qualified international suppliers

Identifying potential buyers and strategic partners

Researching logistics, ports, transportation corridors, and trade considerations

Coordinating communications with suppliers, buyers, attorneys, consultants, and logistics providers

Preparing supplier comparison reports and executive summaries

Tracking negotiations, meetings, documents, and follow-ups

Assisting with preliminary commercial documentation and due diligence



2. DRC Chamber of Commerce Initiative

Supporting the creation and development of a business organization connecting companies, investors, entrepreneurs, institutions, and international partners interested in doing business with the Democratic Republic of Congo.



Responsibilities may include: 

Researching chambers of commerce and international trade organizations

Identifying prospective founding members, sponsors, corporate partners, and institutions

Preparing membership proposals, presentations, correspondence, and research

Coordinating meetings and stakeholder outreach

Maintaining databases of companies and contacts

Assisting with organizational and corporate documentation

Supporting events, partnerships, and membership development 



General Responsibilities



You will also:

Conduct high-quality business and legal research

Prepare concise briefing documents for the founder

Draft professional
s, letters, proposals, presentations, meeting agendas, MOUs, NDAs, and preliminary business documents for review

Maintain project timelines and action items

Follow up consistently with stakeholders

Organize contracts, corporate records, research, and correspondence

Manage projects using ClickUp or similar platforms

Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, analysis, documentation, and project execution

Verify important AI-generated information rather than relying on AI blindly Identify problems, missing information, and recommended next actions



Ideal Background



We are particularly interested in candidates with education or professional experience in one or more of the following:

Business Administration

Law or Paralegal Studies

International Business

International Relations

Corporate Affairs

Economics

Finance

Trade and Logistics

Mining or Commodity Businesses

Government or Institutional Relations



A bachelor's degree is preferred.



Previous experience supporting a CEO, entrepreneur, attorney, consulting firm, international company, chamber of commerce, trade association, government organization, or professional-services firm is highly desirable. 



Required Skills



You should have: 

Excellent written and spoken English

Excellent professional writing skills

Strong research and analytical ability

Strong organizational and follow-up skills

Good understanding of basic business and legal terminology

Ability to work independently

Good professional judgment and discretion

Ability to manage several projects simultaneously

Experience with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace

Familiarity with ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or similar project-management software

Strong experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools professionally



French is a major advantage. 



Knowledge of Africa, international trade, commodities, mining, logistics, corporate affairs, or the Democratic Republic of Congo is also highly valuable. 



The Type of Person We Want



We are not looking for someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every assignment.

For example, you may receive an objective such as: “Identify five credible sulfuric acid suppliers capable of supporting mining operations in Central Africa.”



We expect you to determine how to research the issue, use AI tools intelligently, verify information, organize the findings, identify risks and unanswered questions, and present a concise recommendation. 



We value: Resourcefulness. Judgment. Writing ability. Curiosity. Follow-through. Confidentiality. Speed.



90-Day Contract Period



The successful candidate will initially join under a paid 90-day contract.



During this period, performance will be evaluated based on:

Quality of research

Professional writing

Initiative

Reliability

Organization

Communication

Ability to use AI effectively

Ability to manage follow-ups

Ability to independently move projects forward 



Strong performance may lead to a long-term position with increased responsibility and compensation

. 

Performance or milestone bonuses may also be available for exceptional contribution to major business milestones. 



How to Apply

Please submit:

Your résumé or CV

Your current country and time zone

Your expected monthly compensation

A short description of your business, legal, international, or executive-support experience

A short description of how you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools in your work



Please also answer the following question:

You have been asked to identify and evaluate international sulfuric acid suppliers capable of serving mining companies in the Democratic Republic of Congo. What are the first five steps you would take? 



﻿Please keep your answer concise and practical. Generic AI-generated applications without evidence of independent thinking may not be considered.

title: Video Editor/ Social Media Manager
description:
Video Editor & Social Media Manager — Part-Time

Starting Pay: $5 USD/hour

Hours: Part-Time to Start

Opportunity: Potential to Become Full-Time

Work: Remote

Industry: Real Estate — Florida



🚨 We Are Looking for a FAST, Organized, and Reliable Person

We are looking for a Video Editor & Social Media Manager who is creative, fast, organized, and extremely good at time management.



This is not a position for someone who needs constant reminders or takes several days to complete simple tasks.



We have a consistent daily content schedule, and we need someone who can work efficiently, meet deadlines, follow instructions, and keep content moving every day.



If you are someone who can manage multiple tasks, prioritize your workload, and consistently deliver quality work ON TIME, we want to hear from you.



📱 Daily Content Responsibilities

You will help us create and manage a high volume of social media content for our growing real estate company.



Your regular responsibilities may include:



Creating approximately 2–3 social media posts per day

Creating daily real estate listing posts

Creating daily short-form videos

Creating Reels

Creating carousels

Editing property and real estate videos

Turning raw footage into engaging short-form content

Repurposing existing photos and videos into new content

Creating promotional and educational content

Creating Instagram and
 posts

Creating Google Business Profile posts

Writing attention-grabbing captions

Scheduling and publishing content

Organizing photos, videos, and marketing assets

Maintaining a consistent brand style

Coming up with new content ideas

Keeping our social media calendar organized and up to date

The exact daily workload may change depending on our listings, campaigns, and current marketing priorities.



⏰ TIME MANAGEMENT IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT

This is one of the most important requirements for this position.



We need someone who:



Works quickly without sacrificing quality

Knows how to prioritize tasks

Can manage multiple assignments at the same time

Meets deadlines consistently

Does not need to be chased for completed work

Can follow a content schedule

Can estimate how long tasks will take

Communicates immediately if there is a problem or delay

Can handle revisions quickly

Is dependable and available during agreed working hours

Can stay organized when there are multiple listings and projects

We value speed + quality + consistency.



If you are slow with completing tasks, frequently miss deadlines, or need repeated reminders, this position will probably not be a good fit.



🎬 What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate:



Has strong short-form video editing skills

Has experience creating Reels, TikToks, Shorts, and social media videos

Understands what makes social media content engaging

Has strong graphic design skills

Is experienced with Canva or similar tools

Understands Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, and other social platforms

Has excellent time-management skills

Is highly organized

Has strong attention to detail

Can work independently

Can follow directions exactly

Reads instructions carefully

Has good written English

Communicates clearly and professionally

Meets deadlines

Takes feedback well

Can make revisions quickly

Is willing to learn our company, services, customers, and brand

Is dependable and interested in a long-term position

💻 Software Experience

Experience with any of the following is a plus:



CapCut

Canva

Adobe Premiere Pro

After Effects

Photoshop

Opus Clip

VidIQ

Meta Business Suite

Other video editing, graphic design, or social media management platforms

You do not need to know every program listed above. We care more about your ability to produce high-quality content quickly and consistently.



⭐ We Pay Attention to Instructions

Attention to detail is very important to us.



Please read this job posting carefully.



When applying, you must include the words:



“Customer First”

somewhere in the subject line of your application.



Applications that do not include “Customer First” may not be reviewed.



This is intentional. We want to see that you can follow simple instructions and pay attention to details.

Rate

title: Director of Recruiting — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire staffing firm (healthcare/allied-health core, expanding into new verticals) is hiring a Director of Recruiting to own our ENTIRE delivery organization. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder — every recruiting lane, every recruiter, and the company-wide fill number are yours.



This is a staffing-agency delivery leadership seat, not a corporate HR/TA role. You inherit a live board of open US jobs and a small existing delivery team (including a recruiting manager), and you are accountable for one thing: jobs filled. You set the per-req fill strategy across the whole board, install the standards and cadence, coach and grow the team — and because we're a lean firm, you still personally recruit on the hardest, highest-value searches.



Responsibilities

- Own the company-wide open-req board: triage every US job, set a written fill strategy per req, kill or escalate stalled searches honestly.

- Lead the whole delivery org — the recruiting manager and delivery recruiters report to you; run the daily cadence, set quality-gated submittal standards per recruiter, and manage performance to them.

- Personally recruit full-cycle on priority searches: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit.

- Build the machine: playbooks, screening gates, KPIs, capacity plan; recruit and onboard recruiters as volume grows.

- Report the truth to the founder weekly with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



Required

- 6+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, with 3+ years leading delivery teams measured on submittals and placements — agency/staffing-firm side (BPO/RPO delivery centers serving US staffing firms count; in-house corporate TA does not). Leading team leads or managers is a strong plus.

- US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

- Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements (role, US state, salary) and walk through exactly how you filled them. There WILL be a detailed walkthrough on the interview.

- Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

- Excellent spoken English — you screen US healthcare professionals and coach everyone who does; live spoken check included.

- Fluent with ATS platforms, modern sourcing, and delivery metrics; can build a KPI dashboard, not just read one.

- Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



**Do NOT apply if:** your leadership is in-house corporate TA/HR (not agency delivery); you've led sourcing/CV-mining teams only and never owned submittals-to-fill; you cannot name specific placements you personally closed; you're a pure people-manager who no longer recruits; your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US clinicians; or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: the whole delivery organization is yours — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy, standards, and team build-out, competitive director-level base plus a placement-linked bonus tied to the fills your org produces, fully remote, long-term.



## APPLICATION QUESTIONS

1. The largest delivery organization you've led: company, your title, total headcount (and layers — did team leads/managers report to you?), what the org was measured on, and its typical monthly submittals + placements.

2. Name ONE placement you PERSONALLY closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. *(Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)*

3. Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

4. You inherit this board: ~20 open US direct-hire jobs (mostly healthcare/allied), a recruiting manager, and 2 recruiters; fill rate has been ~20%. In 5–8 sentences: your first 30 days, step by step, and the number you'd promise the founder for day 90.

5. Can you commit to a FIXED US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

6. Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a **30–60 sec voice intro** (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.
