title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — NZ Life Insurance | 60-Day Trial
description:
We're hiring one experienced individual cold caller for a 60-day New Zealand life-insurance appointment-setting trial. If we achieve the commercial targets and it's a good fit on both sides, there is potential for an ongoing role.



THE WORK

High-volume cold outbound calls to supplied NZ leads. Expect frequent refusals and some inactive numbers. Start natural conversations, qualify interested prospects and book agreed, exact-time callbacks with a licensed insurance adviser. You will not sell policies or give financial advice.



Qualification: ages 25–59; NZ citizen or resident; regularly employed or self-employed; and either existing life insurance to compare, or a need for cover such as dependents or a mortgage. Record answers accurately, respect refusals and opt-outs, and never turn a tentative interest into a confirmed booking.



We supply leads, calling tools, CRM and onboarding. Maintain accurate call outcomes, callbacks and booking records. We assess quality conversations and qualified bookings alongside calling activity; dead numbers are not treated as caller failure. Calls and records will be reviewed for coaching and quality assurance.



HOURS AND TRIAL

40 paid hours/week, Monday–Friday, 10am–7pm Auckland time with a one-hour unpaid break. This is 6am–3pm Philippines during NZ standard time and 5am–2pm during NZ daylight saving. You must accommodate both schedules. The 60-day trial starts on your first paid working day and includes onboarding.



PAY

Hourly base plus uncapped performance bonuses for valid qualified bookings. Please state your expected USD hourly base. Exact base, bonus amounts and validation rules will be agreed before starting; no earnings level is guaranteed.



WHO FITS

An individual who personally does the calling, with demonstrated cold-calling and appointment-setting experience, clear telephone communication, resilience after rejection, accurate reporting and the ability to follow a process independently. NZ/Australian consumer calling or insurance experience is useful. Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and a usable headset are required. Agencies or substitute callers are not suitable for this trial.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer these points:

1. Confirm the exact shift above, your earliest start date and any conflicting work commitments.

2. Your expected USD hourly base and interest in base plus booking bonuses.

3. An ordinary recent week of cold calling: campaign/lead type, hours, dial attempts, actual prospect conversations and agreed timed bookings. Label estimates and distinguish cold calls from warm leads or live transfers. Name your dialler/CRM.

4. A 60–90 second voice recording: introduce relevant experience, give a natural cold opener and ask an interested prospect for an exact adviser callback time. A simple phone recording or accessible recording link is fine; do not share confidential customer recordings.

5. Give an example of handling a difficult calling day and maintaining accurate results without close supervision.



Shortlisted applicants will have a 20–25 minute voice interview. Finalists will complete the same paid practical audition and be asked for a recent supervisor reference. Include 2–3 suitable interview times with your timezone.

title: E-Commerce Product Research & Sourcing Specialist
description:
I am launching a U.S.-based online store that will be a one-stop shop for parents sending their children to summer sleepaway camp.



I already have a detailed list of the items we plan to sell (shampoo, bug spray, towels, bedding, flashlights, fans, laundry bags, toiletries, and many other camp essentials).



I am looking for someone with strong product research and sourcing skills to take each item on my list and determine the specific product(s) we should actually sell and the best place for us to buy them.



This is NOT a data-entry job, and I am NOT looking for someone to simply give me a long list of options.



I need someone who can research, compare, use good judgment, and make a recommendation.



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR:



For each item, you will:



Research the available brands/products

Determine what represents good quality and good value

Recommend the exact brand, product, model and size we should sell

Recommend only 1–3 choices per item when appropriate — we do not want to overwhelm customers

Find the best supplier(s) for the selected product

Research wholesale/business pricing when available

Compare case quantities and minimum order requirements

Research shipping/freight costs

Calculate our estimated landed cost per unit

Look for local/regional suppliers and pickup opportunities

Find high-quality manufacturer/supplier product images that can be used on our website and document the source

Provide UPC/SKU information when available

Recommend a reasonable retail price

Calculate estimated gross profit/margin

Explain briefly why you selected that product



QUALITY IS VERY IMPORTANT:



We are NOT trying to sell the cheapest products available.



Our goal is:



Good quality + practical + reliable + best possible cost



Think of it this way:



“Would I be happy sending my own child to camp with this product?”



If yes, then the next question is:



“What is the most economical way for the business to source this quality?”



We do not want poor-quality products simply because they are cheap. We also do not want unnecessarily expensive premium products when a less expensive product will perform just as well.



LOCATION / SHIPPING:



Our business is located in the Detroit, Michigan area, USA.



Shipping and freight are very important, particularly for bulky products such as towels, bedding, pillows, etc.



You should research suppliers throughout the U.S., but pay special attention to:



Michigan suppliers

Ohio, Indiana, Illinois and other nearby Midwest suppliers

Suppliers with warehouses near Michigan

Local pickup opportunities

Free-shipping thresholds

Wholesale distributors that can supply multiple products



The cheapest advertised unit price is NOT necessarily the best supplier.



We care about the total landed cost after shipping/freight.



EXAMPLE:



If the item is BUG SPRAY, don't send me 15 bug sprays.



Research them and tell me something like:



“Based on quality, brand recognition, effectiveness, price, and availability, I recommend that the store carry this specific regular-size product and this specific travel-size product.”



Then show me where we should buy them and what our actual cost will be.



That is the type of research and judgment I am looking for.



EXPERIENCE:



Experience with any of the following is strongly preferred:



E-commerce product research

Wholesale sourcing

Supplier research

Procurement/purchasing

Amazon/Walmart product research

Shopify/e-commerce

Product merchandising

Excel/Google Sheets



You must have excellent attention to detail and be comfortable making recommendations rather than simply collecting information.



PAID TEST:



Before hiring someone for the full project, I will select a few applicants to complete a small PAID 5-product research test.



The test will include several different types of camp products so I can evaluate your product judgment, sourcing ability, research quality, and attention to detail.



If your work is excellent, I would like to hire you for the full product list, and there may be significant additional work as the business grows.



TO APPLY:



Please answer these 4 questions:



Tell me about your experience with product research, sourcing, wholesale suppliers, or e-commerce.

Have you ever been responsible for deciding WHICH specific product a company should sell, rather than simply finding products online? Please explain.

If I asked you to find a good-quality bath towel that I could resell in Michigan at a competitive price, briefly explain how you would research it.

Please begin your application with the words “CAMP STORE” so I know you read the complete posting.



Please include examples of similar work if you have them.

title: Acquisitions Specialist — Outreach, Negotiation & Deal Closing
description:
IF YOU'VE DONE REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS, WHOLESALING, OR DEAL-CLOSING — READ THIS

This is the same work you already do, just a different asset. If you've sourced off-market properties, cold-called owners who weren't listed, negotiated a price, and closed the transfer — you have exactly the skill set we need. Swap "distressed property" for "online community" and the job is identical: find the owner, figure out what it's worth, reach out, and close.



WHO WE ARE

We're a small digital media company that grows and manages niche online communities. We're hiring a sharp closer to acquire them for us. The assets are Reddit communities — but we'll teach you the platform mechanics. What we can't teach is deal instinct and judgment, and that's what we're actually hiring for.



THE JOB, DAY TO DAY

• Start from a list of candidate communities our software pulls for you, and d
 which are worth going after

• Size up each one's real worth — the right niche, genuine demand, real commercial upside — not just the headline numbers

• Track down the owner and reach them across the right channels (often their public social profiles) to open a conversation

• Negotiate and close the deal — either moderation rights or a full ownership transfer

• Coordinate the handoff once terms are agreed

• Keep a tidy pipeline of targets, conversations, deals, and spend



WHAT MATTERS MOST (in this order)

1. Judgment — anyone can read a traffic stat. The rare skill is knowing whether a community is actually worth paying for, and how much, without us in the room for every call.

2. Closing — cold-reaching a stranger, warming them up, negotiating, and getting the deal done. This is the bulk of the work.



Reddit experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement — the platform side is quick to pick up. If you're a strong closer who's never touched Reddit, still apply.



WHO YOU LIKELY ARE

• A real estate acquisitions / disposition VA, wholesaler, cold caller, domain or website flipper, or anyone who sources and closes deals for a living

• You can size up an asset's value fast and be right

• You're comfortable reaching out to strangers and closing them

• You run your own pipeline with little oversight

• Clear written English

• Nice-to-have: Reddit, affiliate, or SEO background



COMPENSATION

Competitive base + a bonus on every deal you close. Strong closers earn well here.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE

1. Walk me through one deal you sourced and closed yourself — a property, domain, website, whatever. How'd you find it, how'd you d
 what it was worth, and how'd you close it?

2. When you size up an online asset, what actually tells you it's worth paying for versus something that just looks big? Be specific.

3. You need to acquire something from an owner who isn't trying to sell. How do you reach them and open the negotiation?

4. Your desired rate or salary.

title: Video Ads editor
description:
# Short-Form Video Editor for Dropshipping / AI UGC



## About the Role



I’m looking for an experienced **Short-Form Video Editor** to work with me on an ongoing basis for my dropshipping business.



The main focus will be creating **high-converting short-form videos** for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels and
.



This is NOT just a basic video editing role.



I need someone who understands how short-form content works and can take successful/reference creatives, understand why they work, and **recreate/adapt them for my target market**.



You will be working closely with me on a regular basis, so I’m looking for someone reliable, fast, creative and interested in a long-term working relationship.



## What You’ll Be Doing



* Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Reels and

* Recreate/adapt successful competitor and reference videos

* Turn existing winning creatives into new variations

* Create and edit **AI UGC-style videos**

* Work with AI-generated actors/avatars, voices and visuals when needed

* Add captions, hooks, transitions, sound effects and other elements that improve retention

* Translate and localize videos for my target market

* Adapt on-screen text so it sounds **natural and native**, not like a literal translation

* Adapt voice-overs into natural-sounding speech for the target language/market

* Replace text and voice-overs while keeping the original structure and pacing of the creative

* Create multiple variations of the same winning concept for testing

* Follow creative briefs and implement feedback quickly

* Research and identify good creative examples when needed



## VERY IMPORTANT



You must be comfortable with **recreating videos from references**.



For example, if I give you a TikTok ad that is performing well, I may ask you to:



1. Analyze the original video

2. Recreate the structure and editing style

3. Adapt the script/text to my market

4. Create or adapt the voice-over

5. Replace the footage where necessary

6. Add appropriate captions, effects and sound

7. Produce a version that feels native to my market rather than like a translated copy



You should have a good understanding of **direct-response advertising and ecommerce creatives**, especially what makes people stop scrolling and continue watching.



## Requirements



**Must have:**



* Proven experience editing **Short-Form Content**

* Strong understanding of TikTok/Reels/Shorts editing

* Experience with **UGC-style content**

* Experience with **AI UGC / AI video tools**

* Excellent attention to detail

* Good understanding of hooks, retention and pacing

* Ability to recreate/adapt videos from references accurately

* Excellent translation/localization skills

* Ability to make translated text and voice-overs sound natural for the target market

* Fast turnaround

* Good communication

* Able to follow instructions and work independently



### Big Plus



Experience with:



* Dropshipping

* Ecommerce advertising

* TikTok Ads

* Meta Ads

* Direct-response marketing

* AI video generation

* AI voice generation

* Creating multiple creative variations for testing



## Tools



I’m open to different editing software, but you should be highly proficient with the tools you use.



Experience with tools such as **CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva, or AI video/voice tools** is a plus.



## What I’m Looking For



I’m looking for someone who is:



* Creative

* Detail-oriented

* Fast

* Reliable

* Proactive

* Good at taking feedback

* Able to work independently

* Interested in a long-term relationship rather than just one-off projects



I care more about the **quality of your work and your ability to produce results** than simply how many years you have been editing.



## Work Arrangement



* **Hourly position**

* Ongoing work

* Flexible schedule

* Remote

* Long-term opportunity for the right person



I expect to start with a smaller number of hours and increase the workload if the collaboration works well.



## How to Apply



Please send me:



1. Your **portfolio/showreel**

2. 3–5 examples of your best **short-form videos**

3. Examples of **UGC or AI UGC** work you've created

4. Your experience with **ecommerce/dropshipping**, if any

5. The editing software and AI tools you use

6. Your **hourly rate**

7. Your weekly availability

8. How quickly you can normally deliver a short-form video



 IMPORTANT — Please answer this question in your application:



**If I send you a successful TikTok ad and ask you to recreate it for another market/language, explain briefly how you would approach the project.**



Applications without a portfolio and without answering this question may not be considered.



I’m looking for someone I can work with **long-term**, so if you’re passionate about short-form content and creative testing, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Full Stack / DevOps Contractor - SaaS Platform (Licensed Cannabis Dispensaries) - Long Term, Start ASAP
description:
About us:



We are ClearCore, a SaaS platform built for licensed cannabis dispensaries. Our software gives dispensaries a full point of sale system, order management, inventory tracking, staff management, compliance tools, and a member loyalty program, all in one place. We are a startup approaching launch and building our team as we go.



About the role:



We are looking for someone to join our team long term as a QA tester who can grow into full stack and DevOps work. Experience with cannabis compliance or METRC is a big plus and will stand out, but not required to apply.



Quick note on METRC for anyone new to the industry: METRC stands for Marijuana Enforcement Tracking Reporting Compliance. It is the seed to sale tracking system that most states require licensed cannabis businesses to use. It tracks cannabis products from the moment they are grown all the way through to the final sale, so the state can confirm everything is accounted for and compliant. You can learn more at metrc.com. Our platform integrates with METRC, and that integration is part of what you would eventually help us build and improve.



What this role looks like starting out:



You will spend your first couple weeks learning our product by testing it. Our platform has three dashboards, Admin, Shops, and Members. Your job is to click through each one daily, find bugs, and log them into our shared Notion doc. We review what you find and make code changes daily on our time zone so we can move fast together.



This role should only take a couple hours a day to start, Monday through Friday. No expectation of weekend work. We want you to actually learn how the product should work before moving into anything technical.



Once you know the front end well, you will get access to our GitHub. From there you can start reading the codebase and helping us improve the backend, including our METRC integration and other APIs.



If you also have front end UI skills, there is room to help improve the UI across all three dashboards and our two marketing websites as well.



Pay structure:

title: Executive Assistant to Owner | Construction Company | Operations + AI + GHL
description:
Executive Assistant to Owner | Construction Company | Operations + AI + GHL



**Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term | U.S. Company



We are looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to work directly with the owner of a growing U.S.-based construction and landscape company.



This is **not a traditional Virtual Assistant position**.



We are not looking for someone who waits for a list of tasks, completes them, and waits for the next instruction.



We are looking for someone who can become the owner's right hand: organize chaos, close open loops, follow up relentlessly, turn ideas into action, improve systems, and eventually help lead other specialized VAs.



The goal of this position is simple:



**Take work off the owner's plate and make sure important things actually get finished.**



As trust and capability grow, this role has the potential to develop from Executive Assistant into an operations and VA leadership position.



About the Company



We are a growing U.S. construction and landscape design-build company.



We are actively building a more systemized company where responsibilities, workflows, SOPs, dashboards, automation, and accountability replace owner dependency.



We are currently building Version 1 of our operating system and intend to reach Version 3 within approximately one year.



You will play an important role in helping us get there.



Who We Need



Non-Negotiable



**1. Excellent spoken and written English**



You will communicate directly with the owner, employees, applicants, vendors, subcontractors, leads, and customers.



You must be confident communicating by
, chat, video, and phone.



**2. Extremely organized**



You naturally create order out of messy information.



You track commitments, deadlines, delegated tasks, follow-ups, documents, meetings, and priorities without allowing things to disappear.



**3. Resourceful**



When you encounter something you do not know, your first instinct should be to investigate, research, use AI, review available documentation, and attempt to solve it.



We value intelligent questions, but we do not want someone who immediately pushes every problem back to the owner.



**4. Extreme accountability**



You take ownership of outcomes.



If you make a mistake, you acknowledge it, correct it, and improve the system so it is less likely to happen again.



As your responsibilities grow, you must also be comfortable holding other team members accountable to clearly defined expectations.



**5. Consistency**



We value consistent, focused execution more than occasional bursts of excellent work.



We need someone dependable every day.



**6. Comfortable working directly with a high-expectation owner**



The owner moves quickly, generates many ideas, delegates heavily, and expects direct communication and follow-through.



Part of your job will be turning that information into organized priorities and completed actions.



**7. Strong follow-through and project management**



You do not consider something complete because an
 was sent.



You follow the task until the outcome is actually achieved.



**8. Positive, solutions-oriented mindset**



We want someone who communicates problems clearly without creating drama, excuses, or unnecessary negativity.



Identify the problem. Recommend a solution. Execute.



**9. Strong AI fluency**



You should already be comfortable using tools such as:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* AI research tools

* AI-assisted writing and analysis



We want someone who uses AI as leverage, not someone who simply copies and pastes AI output.



**10. Leadership mindset**



There is significant growth potential in this role.



We see progression happening in three stages:



**Stage 1: Execution**



Master delegated responsibilities, ask intelligent questions, document what you learn, and execute consistently.



**Stage 2: Systems**



Understand how our company operates and help us improve workflows, SOPs, dashboards, automation, and our overall operating system.



**Stage 3: Leadership**



Help recruit, onboard, manage, and hold accountable specialized VAs.



We eventually expect to employ approximately 5-10 specialized VAs across different functions.



The person who proves they can lead those people creates significant additional value to the company and significant financial growth potential for themselves.



Bonus Points



We will be especially interested if you naturally:



* Identify company bottlenecks

* Document processes

* Build SOPs

* Recommend automation

* Determine what should be delegated

* Help identify the correct role needed

* Recruit people to own those responsibilities

* Build systems that reduce reliance on the owner



We want someone who eventually sees a recurring problem and thinks:



**"How do we make sure this never needs the owner's attention again?"**



## Helpful Experience, But Not Required



You do NOT need experience with every platform below.



Ability to learn quickly matters more than checking every software box.



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



* Google Workspace

* Google Drive

* GoHighLevel

* QuickBooks Online

* ClickUp

* Project management software

* CRM systems

* Construction software

* Construction, landscaping, home services, or trades businesses



What You May Eventually Own



Responsibilities will be handed off progressively rather than all at once.



Potential responsibilities include:



Executive Support



* Manage inbox and calendar

* Maintain the owner's master priority list

* Turn voice notes, conversations, and brain dumps into organized action items

* Schedule meetings and appointments

* Prepare the owner for meetings

* Track delegated work until completion

* Follow up on commitments and deadlines



Operations



* Build and maintain SOPs

* Organize Google Drive

* Maintain company documentation

title: NinjaTrader / NinjaScript Developer | Automated Futures Systems & Product Strategy
description:
KJD Capital is looking for an experienced NinjaTrader 8 / NinjaScript Developer to design, build, test, deploy, and maintain automated futures trading systems.



We are not looking for someone who simply writes indicators or converts basic rules into code. We want a developer who understands futures markets, systematic trading, live execution, risk management, performance validation, and the commercial side of building a high-value automated trading product.



A major objective of this role is to help us develop systems that can progress from research and backtesting into forward testing and live trading, with performance documented through credible live brokerage records.



The ideal candidate can also work with management on product strategy—helping determine which systems, features, risk configurations, and performance characteristics make the product compelling for a high-ticket automated trading offer.



Main Responsibilities

NinjaTrader Strategy Development

Develop automated futures trading strategies in NinjaTrader 8

Write clean and maintainable NinjaScript / C#

Convert trading concepts and detailed specifications into functioning automated systems

Develop new strategies from the ground up

Modify and improve existing strategies

Build custom indicators and supporting tools

Develop sophisticated entry and exit logic

Build stop-loss and profit-target management

Create trailing-stop and break-even functionality

Implement time-of-day and session filters

Build position-sizing and contract-sizing logic

Create daily profit/loss limits and account-level risk controls

Develop multi-timeframe and multi-data-series strategies where necessary

Troubleshoot execution and order-management issues

Live Trading & Performance Validation



This is an important part of the position.



We want someone who understands that a profitable backtest alone is not enough.



You should be able to help take a strategy through:



Concept → Development → Backtest → Optimization → Robustness Testing → Forward Testing → Simulation → Live Deployment → Performance Monitoring



Responsibilities may include:



Conduct realistic backtests

Account for commissions and slippage

Avoid unrealistic fills or backtesting assumptions

Identify potential overfitting

Perform out-of-sample testing

Perform walk-forward or similar robustness testing

Forward-test systems before live deployment

Analyze live execution versus historical results

Troubleshoot discrepancies between backtest and live performance

Monitor slippage and order execution

Improve system stability and reliability

Help establish appropriate risk parameters for live accounts

Maintain accurate strategy versions and performance records



Our objective is to develop strategies capable of establishing credible, verifiable live track records, rather than relying solely on hypothetical backtests.



The developer should understand the importance of maintaining appropriate documentation and broker-generated performance records and never fabricating or overstating live results.



Futures Trading Knowledge



Strong futures knowledge is highly preferred.



You should understand:



NQ / MNQ

ES / MES

GC / MGC

CL

Futures contracts

Tick size and tick value

Contract sizing

Position sizing

Long and short trades

Market, limit, stop, and stop-limit orders

Slippage

Commissions

P&L

Win rate

Profit factor

Average winner / average loser

Risk-to-reward

Maximum drawdown

Trailing drawdown

Sharpe and other performance metrics

Equity curves

Daily loss limits

Prop firm risk requirements

Live brokerage trading



You should be able to look beyond total net profit and determine whether a strategy has a realistic and commercially viable risk profile.



NinjaTrader Expertise



Strong experience with NinjaTrader 8 is required.



You should be comfortable working with:



NinjaScript

C#

NinjaTrader Editor

Strategy Analyzer

Market Replay

Playback

Historical and real-time data

OnBarUpdate()

OnOrderUpdate()

OnExecutionUpdate()

BarsInProgress

Multiple data series

Calculate modes

Tick Replay

Session templates

Trading hours

Strategy states

Managed order handling

Unmanaged order handling where appropriate

Live account execution

Simulation accounts

Brokerage connections



You should understand the differences between historical processing, backtesting, playback, simulation, and live execution.



Strategy Research & Optimization



We want someone who can contribute intellectually to strategy development rather than simply waiting to receive exact coding instructions.



You should be able to:



Evaluate trading ideas

Identify weaknesses in strategy logic

Suggest improvements

Analyze performance distributions

Analyze drawdown characteristics

Determine whether an optimization is likely overfit

Test multiple market conditions

Evaluate performance across different periods

Help determine appropriate risk configurations

Develop different strategy presets when appropriate

Help determine which configurations should be deployed to live accounts



Experience with quantitative research, systematic trading, statistical analysis, Python, or data analysis is a major advantage.



Product & High-Ticket Offer Strategy



This developer will also work with management on the commercial strategy behind the automated trading systems.



You will not necessarily be responsible for closing sales, but we want someone who understands how the technical product contributes to a premium offer.



You may help us:



Determine which strategy configurations should become customer-facing products

Develop different risk profiles and system presets

Identify the most meaningful performance statistics to present to prospects

Explain the technical differentiators of the system

Help our sales team understand how the strategies operate

Prepare technical information for product demonstrations

Help create clear explanations of strategy logic without exposing proprietary intellectual property

Identify features that could increase the value of the product

Help determine how the product should be positioned for serious futures traders

Assist management with the technical side of a high-ticket automated trading offer



The goal is to create a product where the software, live performance history, risk controls, documentation, onboarding experience, and sales presentation all support the value of the offering.



Marketing and sales materials must accurately distinguish live results, simulated results, and hypothetical/backtested performance.



Prop Firm & Live Brokerage Knowledge



Experience with both environments is highly preferred.



You should understand the differences between:



Prop Firm Trading



Funded accounts

Evaluation accounts

Trailing drawdown

Daily loss limits

Consistency requirements

Contract limits



and:



Live Brokerage Trading



Real capital

Brokerage connections

Commissions

Slippage

Order routing

Live fills

Account-level risk management



Experience with NinjaTrader Brokerage and Tradovate is a major plus.



AI & Codex Experience



Experience using OpenAI Codex or similar AI-assisted development tools is highly preferred.



We want a developer who knows how to use modern AI development tools to:



Accelerate development

Debug NinjaScript

Refactor code

Build internal tools

Analyze logs

Create testing utilities

Develop reporting tools

Work with APIs and integrations

Automate repetitive development processes



AI should accelerate your work—not replace your understanding of C#, NinjaTrader, or trading-system architecture.



Requirements



The ideal candidate has:



Strong NinjaTrader 8 experience

Strong NinjaScript experience

Strong C# development skills

Previous automated strategy development experience

Understanding of futures markets

Understanding of algorithmic/systematic trading

Experience with backtesting and forward testing

Experience deploying strategies in live or realistic trading environments

Strong understanding of risk management

Strong debugging skills

Ability to analyze trading statistics

Ability to document work clearly

Excellent communication

Ability to work directly with management

Ability to think strategically rather than simply complete coding tickets

High attention to detail

Ability to protect proprietary source code and trading logic

Major Plus

Previous strategies with documented live deployment experience

Quantitative research experience

Python

SQL

APIs

Git/GitHub

OpenAI Codex

Tradovate

Brokerage APIs

Prop firm experience

Trading-system licensing or protection experience

Software product development experience

Who We're Looking For



We want someone who can do more than say:



"The backtest looks profitable."



We want someone who can ask:



Is the strategy robust?



Is it overfit?



What happens after commissions and slippage?



Does it behave correctly in live execution?



What is the realistic drawdown?



How should position sizing change based on account size?



Can this system establish a credible live performance history?



What would make this system valuable enough to become a premium commercial product?



That is the level of developer we are looking for.



When Applying, Please Answer

How many years have you worked with NinjaTrader 8 and NinjaScript?

Please describe automated futures strategies you have previously developed.

Have any strategies you developed been deployed to live brokerage accounts?

Have you worked with systems that have established documented live performance histories?

What futures markets have you developed systems for?

Explain how you prevent overfitting when developing a trading strategy.

How do you account for commissions and slippage in testing?

Explain the difference between a backtest, forward test, simulation, and live performance.

How would you investigate a strategy that performs well historically but poorly live?

What NinjaTrader order-management methods do you normally use?

Have you built multi-timeframe or multi-instrument NinjaTrader strategies?

What experience do you have with NinjaTrader Brokerage or Tradovate?

Have you developed systems specifically for prop firms?

What experience do you have with Python, APIs, GitHub, or Codex?

Please provide examples of previous NinjaTrader work or code samples you are legally permitted to share.

Please describe one automated system you helped take from initial concept through live deployment.

How would you evaluate whether a trading system is strong enough to become a premium/high-ticket commercial product?



We are looking for a long-term developer who can help KJD Capital build serious automated futures products—not simply complete one-off NinjaScript projects.

title: STR Claims & Damage Recovery Specialist — Guesty Shield / Truvi

This is not an administrative VA role. Your job is to turn legitimate guest-caused damages and covered losses into properly documented, maximized recoveries while following platform and protection-plan requirements.



You will manage claims start to finish, with a heavy focus on Guesty Shield and Truvi, as well as Airbnb/AirCover and other applicable channels.



Responsibilities



* Identify every legitimate reimbursable i

* File and manage claims from initial documentation through final resolution

* Collect photos, videos, invoices, receipts, cleaner/vendor statements, timelines, and supporting evidence

* Build organized, persuasive claim packages

* Understand deadlines, exclusions, depreciation, documentation standards, and reimbursement rules

* Follow up aggressively and professionally on outstanding claims

* Respond to requests for additional documentation

* Challenge/appeal underpaid or denied claims when appropriate

* Coordinate with cleaners, maintenance teams, vendors, and management to obtain evidence quickly

* Maintain a claims tracker showing amount claimed, amount approved, amount collected, status, reason for reductions/denials, and turnaround time

* Analyze past claims to identify money we are leaving on the table

* Improve our internal documentation/SOPs so future claims have stronger evidence



This Position MUST Produce ROI



We are not looking to add another overhead position.



We want someone who can demonstrate that the incremental legitimate recoveries they generate materially exceed the cost of employing them.



Your performance will be measured heavily on:

$ legitimately recovered, recovery rate, avoidable denial rate, turnaround time, and net ROI after your compensation.



We will never expect fabricated, inflated, duplicate, or unsupported claims. Maximum payout means recovering every dollar legitimately owed under the applicable coverage and documentation—not gaming the system.



REQUIRED — Prove You Can Do This



Do not apply with a generic VA application.



Your application MUST answer:



1. How many STR damage/protection claims have you personally managed?

2. Approximately how much money have you successfully recovered?

3. What was your approximate approval/recovery rate?

4. What is the largest claim you personally got paid, and how much was recovered?

10. What KPIs would you report to us every week?

11. Provide a 2–3 minute video introduction explaining your claims experience and why you believe you can recover more money than you cost us.



Bonus: Include a redacted example of a real STR claim you personally managed, showing the original claim amount, documentation/process, and final amount recovered.



Compensation



Competitive Philippines-based salary + performance incentives tied to legitimate successful recoveries.

title: AI Implementation & Automation Expert — Real Estate / Short-Term Rentals
description:
We are looking for an exceptionally strong AI implementation expert to come into an established real estate and short-term rental business and systematically identify, build, and deploy AI across the company.



I am NOT looking for someone who simply knows how to use ChatGPT.



I want someone who can understand our business at a deep level, find inefficiencies and opportunities I haven’t identified, and then actually build and implement the solutions.



Our business includes a large STR/Airbnb portfolio, property management, acquisitions, renovations/construction, maintenance, cleaners/vendors, guest communication, claims, revenue management, bookkeeping/admin, and direct-to-seller real estate acquisitions.



What You Will Do



Your first responsibility is to learn our business inside and out.



Then audit every department and determine where AI, automation, integrations, and better systems can:



* Reduce labor and VA hours

* Eliminate repetitive administrative work

* Improve guest communication

* Improve maintenance/vendor coordination

* Automate cleaner and turnover oversight

* Analyze guest messages and automatically identify problems

* Improve STR claims documentation and recovery

* Automate review and reputation management

* Analyze property and operational performance

* Improve pricing/revenue-management workflows

* Automate owner/property reporting

* Improve direct-to-seller lead generation and follow-up

* Analyze acquisition opportunities

* Automate CRM workflows

* Improve construction/project-management workflows

* Organize invoices, receipts, photos, documents, and property information

* Build internal AI assistants/agents that understand our properties and SOPs

* Connect our existing software so information flows automatically

* Identify problems and opportunities before I have to ask



You should be comfortable working with tools such as OpenAI/LLMs, APIs, webhooks, n8n/Make/Zapier, CRMs, PMS platforms, Google Workspace, databases, and custom AI agents/workflows.



I Want a Builder, Not a Consultant



I don’t need someone to give me a 40-page report explaining what AI could do.



I need someone who can say:



“This process currently takes your team 30 hours per month. I can automate 80% of it. Here’s how, here’s what it will cost, and here’s the measurable ROI.”



Then build it, test it, deploy it, document it, and make sure the team actually uses it.



You Need to Be Exceptional



Do not apply because you have built a few Zapier automations or are good at prompting ChatGPT.



I’m looking for someone who is unusually good at:



AI + automation + business operations + problem solving.



Real estate, Airbnb/STR, property management, hospitality, or construction experience is a major advantage.



PROVE IT IN YOUR APPLICATION



Generic applications will be ignored.



Answer ALL of these:



1. What are the 3 most sophisticated AI/automation systems you’ve personally built? Explain exactly what they did and the measurable result.

2. Give an example where your work eliminated significant labor or reduced operating costs. Quantify it.

3. What AI models, automation platforms, APIs, databases, and development tools can you personally work with?

4. What have you built involving APIs/webhooks rather than simple no-code automations?

5. What experience do you have with real estate, STRs, Airbnb, property management, hospitality, or construction?

6. Assume we manage 20+ STR properties. Give me 5 AI implementations you would investigate first and explain why.

7. How would you make an AI system understand each individual property’s information, SOPs, maintenance history, vendors, and previous guest issues?

8. Give me an example of something you believe most businesses are still paying humans to do that AI should already be handling.

9. How would you measure whether your position is producing positive ROI for me every month?

10. Send a 3–5 minute Loom/video showing me an AI system you personally built. Show the actual workflow/backend—not just the finished interface.



First 30 Days



If hired, I expect you to learn the business, interview the team, map our workflows, identify the highest-ROI opportunities, prioritize them, and begin deploying solutions.



Every proposed project should have an estimated:



Build cost → hours saved → dollars saved/generated → implementation time → expected ROI.



Compensation



Part-time initially.



I am willing to pay well above typical OnlineJobs.ph rates for an exceptional person.



I am not interested in the cheapest applicant. I am interested in finding someone so capable that keeping them becomes an obvious financial decision.



There is significant opportunity to increase hours, compensation, and responsibility if you can prove measurable ROI.

description:
PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING.



About Us



Vantage Point Agency is a growing US-based digital marketing and creative agency. We have served 50+ clients and are looking for a team of video editors not a one-time freelancer.



We want someone who wants to grow with us, improve their skills, and eventually take greater leadership within our creative team of editors.



The Role



We are looking for a highly skilled, dependable, and creative Video Editor who understands storytelling not just how to cut videos.



Our team produces approximately 80–100 pieces of quality video content every month, including:



* Reels, TikToks & YouTube Shorts

* Talking-head content

* Quote/text-based videos

* Promotional & brand storytelling content



Technical Skills — REQUIRED



You must be comfortable with:

* CapCut for fast-paced and short-form editing workflows

* Professional color correction & color grading

* Editing footage captured on Sony cinematic cameras

* Working with LOG/flat footage and creating a polished final look

* 4K editing and exports

* Audio cleanup and mixing

* Captions and on-screen graphics

* B-roll and visual storytelling

* Music and sound design

* Short-form AND long-form editing

Premiere Pro is our primary professional editing platform, but we also value editors who know how to use CapCut efficiently when it makes sense for short-form content and faster workflows.



We will provide access to Epidemic Sound for professional music and sound effects.



### Storytelling Matters



We don't want editors who simply cut clips and add captions. You should understand pacing, emotion, B-roll, music, hooks, sound design, and visual storytelling.



Because our clients are primarily US-based, you must also understand how to select accurate US-based B-roll and visuals. If someone is talking about Tampa, show Tampa FL. If they're talking about American football, don't show soccer.



If you don't understand a reference, research it before choosing the footage.



Quality Is Non-Negotiable



Our goal isn't simply to produce 80–100 videos.



It's to have 80–100 QUALITY pieces of content ready every month.



Before a video reaches our leadership team or a client, it should have:



* No typos

* No caption mistakes

* No obvious editing errors

* Accurate B-roll

* Professional color grading

* Clean audio

* Correct branding

* Correct formatting and exports

* Strong pacing and storytelling



Growth & Leadership



We want someone who is hungry to get better.



You should be willing to learn new editing styles, advanced Premiere Pro and CapCut techniques, AI tools, and emerging creative technology.



We don't want you doing the exact same type of editing a year from now.



As you grow, there is an opportunity to help lead our editing team, review other editors' work, maintain quality, manage deadlines, and make sure every editor knows what they are responsible for.



Video Editor → Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Team Leader



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



This position requires an experienced video editor. Please do not apply if:



* You only know basic video cuts and captions.

* You do not know how to color correct and color grade video.

* You are not comfortable editing 4K footage from Sony cinematic cameras.

* You do not understand storytelling, pacing, and how to keep viewers watching.

* You use random B-roll instead of choosing footage that matches what the person is saying.

* You often miss spelling mistakes, caption errors, or other small details.

* You need step-by-step instructions for every video.

* You are not willing to learn and improve your skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, AI tools, and new editing technology.

description:

This role is ideally intended for candidates who already have experience working with homeowners associations. This is not an entry-level role. A candidate without Homeowners Association Management (HOA) or Community Association Management (CAM) experience would be considered, but they would need to have considerable administrative experience.



This is not a short-term contract position.



Key Responsibilities

s and service requests

• Coordinate with vendors and follow up on work orders

Systems and Training

title: Senior Construction Project Manager — Residential / STR Renovations
description:
READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



This will probably be the hardest position in my company to replace me in.



I am an extremely hands-on owner and a licensed General Contractor. I have personally managed hundreds of thousands of dollars in renovations, major residential projects, and complicated STR builds. I am involved in scopes, pricing, contractor selection, materials, design decisions, problem solving, scheduling, and quality control.



I currently plan to continue managing my own construction projects.



I am posting this because there is a chance that an exceptional construction project manager exists who can actually manage these projects better than I can.



If that’s you, I want to meet you.



If you need me to tell you what to do every day, do not apply.



If your idea of project management is updating a spreadsheet and asking contractors for updates, do not apply.



If you cannot look at a construction problem, understand what’s happening, challenge a contractor, compare solutions, negotiate pricing, and drive the project forward without me, do not apply.



The Standard



I don’t need an assistant for construction.



I need someone capable of replacing me as the person driving the project.



You should eventually know:



What is happening → what should be happening → what’s behind schedule → who’s responsible → what decision needs made → what it should cost → and what happens next.



Ideally, you tell me what needs to happen—not the other way around.



Our Projects



These aren’t cookie-cutter apartment turns.



Projects can include:



* Large luxury STR renovations

* 5,000–10,000+ sq. ft. homes

* Indoor pools and pool rooms

* HVAC and mechanical systems

* Plumbing and electrical

* Septic systems

* Foundations and structural work

* Roofing and exterior projects

* Flooring, cabinetry and finish carpentry

* Excavation, grading, roads and drainage

* Landscaping and large acreage properties

* Amenity construction

* New cabins and larger ground-up developments

* Furnishing and final STR launch

* Multiple contractors working simultaneously



You don’t have to personally be an expert tradesperson in every category.



But you need enough construction knowledge to know when someone is feeding you bullshit.



What You Would Own



You would eventually be responsible for:



* Creating detailed scopes of work

* Breaking projects into phases and critical paths

* Soliciting and comparing multiple bids

* Finding and vetting contractors

* Negotiating labor and material pricing

* Reviewing estimates for missing scope and inflated pricing

* Building project budgets

* Tracking actual vs. budget

* Scheduling trades in the correct sequence

* Ordering and tracking materials

* Preventing material shortages from delaying jobs

* Coordinating contractors remotely

* Reviewing daily job-site photos/videos

* Maintaining punch lists

* Verifying work before payments are released

* Tracking change orders

* Catching mistakes before they become expensive

* Following up relentlessly

* Keeping contractors accountable to schedules

* Escalating only decisions that actually require ownership

* Giving me a concise dashboard of every project’s budget, schedule, problems and next actions



I Am Extremely Involved



Understand this before applying:



You are not walking into a company where the owner doesn’t understand construction.



I will question your recommendations.



I will question bids.



I will notice things.



I will ask why.



And if I can manage the project faster, cheaper, or better myself, there is no reason for this position to exist.



That isn’t meant to intimidate the right person.



The right person should read that and see an opportunity.



The Person I’m Looking For



I want someone who is:



Relentless. Organized. Construction-smart. Financially sharp. Extremely proactive. Difficult to bullshit. Excellent with contractors. Excellent at negotiation. Obsessed with follow-through.



You need to think like an owner, not an employee.



Saving $20,000 through better bidding matters.



Catching a $30,000 mistake before construction matters.



Getting a property launched four weeks earlier matters.



Finding a better contractor matters.



Sending me a beautiful spreadsheet while a project runs three months late does not matter.



PROVE YOU’RE BETTER THAN ME



Do not send me a generic application.



Answer every question below:



1. What is the largest construction/renovation project you’ve personally managed? Give me the budget, square footage, timeline and scope.

2. How many projects have you managed simultaneously?

3. Give me an example where you caught a contractor’s mistake before it became an expensive problem. What would it have cost if you hadn’t caught it?

4. Give me an example where you negotiated a contractor/vendor price down. Original price, final price, and how you did it.

5. Tell me about a project that was behind schedule. What specifically did you do to recover the schedule?

6. A contractor gives you a $70,000 bid that just says “HVAC replacement — labor and materials.” What do you do next?

7. Two contractors bid the same project at $42,000 and $71,000. Walk me through exactly how you determine which bid is actually better.

8. A contractor tells you something unexpected will cost another $18,000. What do you require before approving the change order?

9. How would you remotely verify that work is actually completed correctly before releasing payment?

10. What construction software/project-management systems have you used?

11. What construction trades do you understand well enough to challenge a contractor’s scope or recommendation?

12. Tell me about your worst construction mistake. What did you miss, how much did it cost, and what system did you implement so it never happened again?



FINAL TEST



Send me a 3–5 minute video.



Don’t spend the video telling me you’re hardworking.



Pick one complicated project you personally managed and show me:



Scope → budget → schedule → contractor management → major problems → your decisions → final result.



If possible, show actual redacted schedules, budgets, scopes, bids, progress photos, or project-management systems.



Compensation



I am willing to pay well above typical OnlineJobs.ph compensation for the right person.



But this isn’t a position I’m desperate to fill.



If I don’t find someone exceptional, I will continue doing it myself.



The person I hire needs to create enough value through better pricing, tighter schedules, fewer mistakes, better contractor management, and less of my time that hiring them becomes an obvious decision.



If you think you can manage my construction projects better than I can, prove it.

title: Inbound Sales & Client Services Representative
description:
Inbound Sales & Support Representative



ABOUT US

--------------------

We are an e-commerce business specializing in hydroponic equipment serving North America. We are a small, dynamic team looking for a long-term partner who will become the primary customer representative of the company.



ABOUT THE ROLE

--------------------

We're hiring a remote dedicated Inbound Sales & Support Representative to own the front line of our customer experience.



As a key member, you'll have the opportunity to work remotely while directly shaping the success of our valued customers.



You'll answer calls, chats,
s, walk customers through our products, and close sales — while qualifying larger commercial leads for handoff to our sales manager.





Hours: 8am to 1pm PST



WHAT YOU'LL DO

--------------------

Answer inbound calls promptly — pick up live calls within a few rings or less.

Resolve routine retail support — shipment tracking, parts questions, order status, and general customer inquiries, start to finish.

Re-engage abandoned-cart shoppers and follow up on stalled quotes through outbound and cold calling.

Walk customers through our product lineup with clarity, confidence, and accurate detail

Work through objections, pricing pushback, and follow-ups without losing momentum, while staying alert to upsell and cross-sell openings.

Qualify incoming commercial inquiries — run a short intake call to understand scope and need, then hand off pre-qualified leads to our sales manager with clear notes.

Own the queue during scheduled leadership absences — during planned coverage windows, you're the single point of contact for all customer communications. High-value orders and urgent escalations get flagged for a same-day leadership review; everything else you handle directly.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

--------------------

Callers consistently reach a real person quickly — no missed calls, no long holds.

Retail issues get resolved on first contact whenever possible.

100% of leads are entered into the CRM, ready and pre-qualified for the sales manager.

Leadership can step away (including multi-day stretches) without customer experience slipping.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

--------------------

Experience in customer support, inside sales, or sales development — retail, e-commerce, or B2B distribution background is a plus.

Clear, confident spoken and written English communication skills, with an outgoing, people-first personality.

Sharp communication paired with genuine listening skills — comfortable being the first voice a customer hears, on the phone and in writing.

Organized and self-directed — you can triage, prioritize, and make good judgment calls without someone looking over your shoulder.

Calm, professional communication style with both everyday retail customers and commercial buyers.

Quick to learn, dependable in execution, and careful with instructions.



BONUS POINTS FOR

--------------------

Comfortable working daily inside Shopify to track orders, leads, monitor abandoned carts, and flag opportunities.

Familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

Understanding of AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude AI, etc.



HOW TO APPLY (MUST READ)

--------------------

Send the following:



Your resume

A 60–90 second voice recording (required) covering both parts below:



Voice Recording — what to include:



A. Quick intro: your name and one sentence on your background & sales experience.



B. Live sales scenario: Imagine you're calling a customer who added a vacuum cleaner to their cart but didn't check out. Walk us through how you'd turn that abandoned cart into a sale — including how you'd handle the objection "I'm not ready to buy right now."



We're evaluating tone, confidence, clarity, listening cues, and how naturally you move a prospect toward a close. Polish matters; perfection isn't expected — show us how you actually sound on a real call.



Applications without a voice recording that completes both parts will not be considered. Please include the word REAL in your subject line to confirm you've read this far.



Thank you.

title: Chief of Staff / Executive Operations Manager — Real Estate & Short-Term Rentals
description:
READ THIS FIRST



I am looking for someone who can eventually become my right hand across the entire business.



This is NOT an Executive Assistant position.



I don’t need someone to manage my calendar, take notes, remind me about tasks, or wait for instructions.



I need an absolute execution monster who can take the hundreds of moving pieces in my business, organize them, drive people to completion, solve problems independently, and dramatically reduce how much I personally have to manage.



My businesses involve:



* 20+ short-term rentals

* Property management

* Large renovation and construction projects

* Real estate acquisitions

* Direct-to-seller marketing

* Contractors and maintenance teams

* Cleaners and vendors

* Claims and damage recovery

* Financing and lenders

* New property launches

* Large acreage/development projects

* VAs and remote employees

* AI/automation implementation



There are constantly dozens of projects and hundreds of follow-ups happening simultaneously.



Your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped.



⸻



YOUR JOB IS TO CREATE LEVERAGE FOR ME



If I tell you:



“Get me three HVAC quotes for this property, figure out why the septic contractor hasn’t responded, make sure the lender has the revised scope, get an answer from the excavator, find out why this Airbnb claim hasn’t been paid, and make sure the new listing launches Friday.”



I should not need to ask about those things again.



You figure out:



Who needs contacted → what information is missing → who owns it → what the deadline is → what needs followed up on → what can be solved without me → and what actually requires my decision.



Then you drive everything forward.



I DON’T WANT PROBLEMS BROUGHT TO ME



Whenever possible, I want:



Problem → research → options → your recommendation → decision needed from me.



Not:



“What do you want me to do?”



⸻



What You Will Own



You will eventually oversee and coordinate execution across the business.



That includes:



* Maintaining the master company/project priority list

* Turning my ideas and conversations into actionable projects

* Assigning responsibilities and deadlines

* Following up relentlessly until tasks are completed

* Holding employees and contractors accountable

* Coordinating VAs and department leads

* Tracking construction and renovation projects

* Tracking property launches

* Coordinating lenders, contractors, vendors and service providers

* Making sure important
s/messages receive responses

* Researching problems before bringing them to me

* Obtaining quotes and comparing options

* Preparing decisions for me

* Running weekly accountability meetings

* Tracking KPIs across departments

* Identifying bottlenecks

* Improving SOPs and company systems

* Working with our AI/automation person to eliminate unnecessary manual work

* Catching problems before I notice them

* Making sure something I mentioned three weeks ago doesn’t disappear because I stopped talking about it



Eventually, you should understand my businesses well enough to know what I am going to ask before I ask it.



⸻



THIS POSITION WILL NOT BE EASY



I move quickly.



I have a lot happening simultaneously.



Priorities can change.



I ask a lot of questions.



I generate new ideas constantly.



I expect people to follow through.



And I have very little patience for repeatedly asking about something that should already have been handled.



If you need an extremely structured corporate environment where someone gives you five tasks every morning, this position will be miserable for you.



But if you love taking chaos and turning it into execution, you may absolutely thrive here.



⸻



I NEED SOMEONE BETTER ORGANIZED THAN I AM



You should be the person saying:



“You mentioned this two weeks ago. Here’s where it stands.”



“We’re waiting on these three people. I’ve already followed up twice.”



“This contractor’s quote doesn’t make sense. I got two alternatives.”



“This project will miss its deadline unless we make this decision today.”



“You don’t need to handle this. I already solved it.”



That’s the level I’m looking for.



⸻



THE GOAL



Eventually, I want the organizational structure to look something like:



Owner/CEO → Chief of Staff → Department Leads / Specialists / VAs



I don’t want to personally manage eight different employees and constantly check whether things happened.



You make sure they happen.



That means you must be comfortable holding other people accountable—even people with specialized expertise you don’t personally have.



⸻



DO NOT APPLY IF:



* You are primarily an Executive Assistant

* You need detailed instructions for every task

* You are afraid to make decisions

* You avoid uncomfortable follow-ups

* You aren’t comfortable holding people accountable

* You regularly forget things

* You wait several days before following up

* You think updating a task-management system = getting something accomplished

* You send problems upward without first trying to solve them

* You become overwhelmed when 20 things happen simultaneously



I would rather not fill this position than hire an average person.



⸻



PROVE YOU’RE THE PERSON



Generic applications will be ignored.



Answer ALL of these:



1. What is the most complicated business/operation you’ve personally helped run? How many employees, projects, customers, or locations were involved?



2. Tell me about an executive/founder you supported who had too many things happening simultaneously. How did you create order?



3. Give me an example where your boss gave you a vague objective instead of instructions. What did you do?



4. Tell me about something important that would have been forgotten or missed if you hadn’t caught it.



5. Give me an example where you had to hold an employee, contractor, or vendor accountable when they weren’t performing.



6. Your boss gives you 30 unrelated tasks in one conversation. Walk me through exactly what happens afterward.



7. You need an answer from a contractor today. You’ve called twice, texted, and
ed with no response. What do you do?



8. Three employees tell you their tasks are delayed because they’re waiting on other people. What do you do?



9. Tell me about a decision you made without asking your boss first. Why did you feel comfortable making it?



10. What information would you want from me during your first 30 days so you could eventually begin anticipating what I need?



11. What systems have you personally used to manage complex projects, teams, SOPs, communication, and accountability?



12. What experience do you have with real estate, construction, property management, Airbnb/STRs, hospitality, or investing?



MOST IMPORTANT QUESTION:



13. Assume I disappear for 7 days and barely respond to you. What specifically would you do to make sure the business continues moving forward without me?



⸻



VIDEO REQUIRED



Send a 3–5 minute video.



Tell me about the most chaotic operation, company, executive, or project you’ve ever managed.



Explain:



What was happening → why it was difficult → what YOU took ownership of → systems you created → problems you solved → measurable result.



Don’t tell me you’re organized.



Show me evidence that you’ve operated at this level.



⸻



Compensation



I am willing to pay well above typical OnlineJobs.ph compensation for an exceptional person.



I’m not looking for cheap labor.



I’m looking for leverage.



If hiring you gives me back significant hours every week, makes the rest of my team perform better, prevents expensive mistakes, and allows the company to grow without everything flowing through me, you will be extremely valuable to me.



There is substantial room for increased compensation and responsibility for someone who becomes indispensable.



If you’re the kind of person who sees 100 moving pieces and immediately wants to take control of them, I want to hear from you.

title: Experienced Credit Repair Specialist – FCRA/CFPB
description:
## Experienced Credit Repair Specialist Needed



We are looking for an experienced **Credit Repair Specialist / Credit Dispute Specialist** who understands U.S. consumer credit laws and can independently review credit reports, identify inaccurate or questionable negative items, prepare customized disputes, and properly document all activity inside **Credit Repair Cloud**.



### REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE



You must be familiar with:



* FCRA — Fair Credit Reporting Act

* FACTA — Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act

* FDCPA — Fair Debt Collection Practices Act

* CFPB complaint procedures

* FTC Identity Theft procedures

* HIPAA as it relates to applicable medical debt/privacy situations

* Credit bureau dispute procedures

* Creditor and collection agency disputes

* Identity theft blocking procedures

* Consumer reporting agency freezes



### CREDIT REPAIR CLOUD EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



You must have experience using **Credit Repair Cloud** as a credit repair CRM.



You should know how to:



* Add and manage clients

* Import/analyze credit reports

* Track negative tradelines

* Track dispute rounds

* Update client progress

* Update CRM at the 15-day, 30-day, and 45-day stages

* Track dispute letters that have been sent

* Record bureau responses

* Track deletions and account updates

* Record creditor and collection agency responses

* Create and manage follow-up actions

* Keep detailed client notes

* Maintain organized client files and documentation

* Track the complete dispute history for each client



### CREDIT REPORT EXPERIENCE



You must know how to analyze credit reports from platforms such as:



* Experian

* Equifax

* TransUnion

* MyFICO

* SmartCredit

* IdentityIQ

* PrivacyGuard

* Credit Karma

* Identity Guard

* Other credit monitoring platforms



You should be able to identify and analyze:



* Collections

* Charge-offs

* Late payments

* Repossessions

* Closed derogatory accounts

* Inaccurate balances

* Duplicate accounts

* Incorrect account statuses

* Incorrect dates

* Payment history inconsistencies

* Accounts reporting differently between bureaus

* Unauthorized hard inquiries

* Potential identity theft accounts

* Other inaccurate or unverifiable information



### RESPONSIBILITIES



The selected specialist will be responsible for:



* Reviewing all three credit bureaus

* Identifying negative tradelines

* Identifying inconsistencies between Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion

* Developing an appropriate dispute strategy for each client

* Creating customized dispute letters for Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion

* Creating customized letters for original creditors

* Creating customized letters for collection agencies and debt buyers

* Preparing follow-up disputes when necessary

* Updating **Credit Repair Cloud** throughout the dispute process

* Updating client files approximately every 15, 30, and 45 days

* Keeping detailed records of disputes, responses, deletions, updates, and next actions

* Reviewing bureau investigation results

* Reviewing creditor and collector responses

* Escalating legitimate unresolved reporting issues when appropriate



### FREEZE EXPERIENCE



You should know how to properly submit and manage security freezes or freeze requests with:



* Equifax

* Experian

* TransUnion

* LexisNexis

* Innovis

* ARS

* CoreLogic

* SageStream



You should understand when a freeze is appropriate and when it is not.



### CFPB / FTC EXPERIENCE



You must understand how to:



* Prepare and submit legitimate CFPB complaints

* Include supporting documentation

* Create a clear timeline of the dispute

* Determine when CFPB escalation is appropriate

* Properly use FTC IdentityTheft.gov procedures for legitimate identity theft cases

* Prepare supporting documentation for legitimate identity theft disputes



**We will not use false identity theft claims or fraudulent dispute tactics.**



### IMPORTANT



We are NOT looking for someone who simply sends the same generic dispute template to every client.



We want someone who understands the complete process:



**Analyze → Identify inaccuracies/inconsistencies → Determine the correct dispute strategy → Create customized disputes → Track everything in Credit Repair Cloud → Review responses → Follow up → Escalate when justified**



Attention to detail and organization are extremely important.



### TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. How many years have you worked in credit repair?

2. Approximately how many client credit files have you handled?

3. How many years of experience do you have using **Credit Repair Cloud**?

4. What tasks have you personally performed inside Credit Repair Cloud?

5. Which credit monitoring platforms are you experienced with?

6. Explain the difference between an FCRA dispute and an FDCPA dispute.

7. When would you dispute directly with a creditor or furnisher instead of only disputing with the credit bureaus?

8. What would you look for when the same account is reporting differently between Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion?

9. Have you prepared CFPB complaints before? Explain your experience.

10. Have you handled legitimate identity theft disputes involving FTC Identity Theft Reports?

11. Are you experienced with LexisNexis, Innovis, CoreLogic, SageStream, and ARS freezes?

12. What is your process after receiving a bureau investigation result?

13. What information do you normally track inside Credit Repair Cloud during a 30–45 day dispute cycle?

14. How do you determine whether to send another dispute, dispute with the furnisher, or escalate the issue?



Please start your onlinejobs.ph proposal with the words:



**“CREDIT REPAIR CLOUD”**



If you do not include those words, your application may not be reviewed.



We are looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, and experienced who can potentially work with us **long term as our client volume grows**.

title: PAID VA INTERNSHIPS: REAL WORK, REAL PORTFOLIO
description:
We Don't Just Hire VAs. We Build Them.



Position Summary

Elorae works with education programs such as Leaders Academy in Korea. Our team produces curriculum, events, marketing, media, websites, operations support, and other work that is used by real students, parents, teachers, and partners.



We are opening paid internship positions for college students in the Philippines who want to do real work, build a real portfolio, and learn how a remote international team actually operates.



This is not a coffee-fetching internship and it is not an unpaid "experience" arrangement. You will join an active workstream and produce work that matters.



How It Works

Interns are a cross-cutting layer across our teams. You apply to the area that best matches your skills and interests.



Curriculum

• Curriculum Assistant

• Copyeditor



Marketing

• Graphic Designer

• Media Editor

• Social Media Manager

• Web Developer



Operations

• Personal Assistant

• Events Coordinator

• Bookkeeping Assistant



Specialists

• Tutor

• Other specialist roles may be considered if you can make a strong case



You are not locked into one tiny task forever. Strong interns may contribute across related areas, but we start by finding the work you can actually do well.



What You Need

You must be currently enrolled in a college or university in the Philippines and be at least a second-year student.



You need:

• Strong working English

• Your own laptop or desktop for roles that require one

• Stable internet, minimum 30 Mbps download with acceptable latency

• A workspace where you can focus and join video calls

• Enough maturity to meet deadlines without being chased

• A willingness to learn from direct feedback and revise your work



For design, media, web, curriculum, editing, and other portfolio-based roles, show us what you have already made. Student work is fine if it is genuinely yours and genuinely good.



What You Get

This is paid work at 100 PHP per hour from day one.



You get real assignments, real feedback, and portfolio material from active programs. If your school requires official documentation for practicum, OJT, or academic credit, we can coordinate directly with your institution.



Strong interns are also the first people we look at when regular paid VA positions open. We prefer to promote people whose work we already know.



September Philippines Interviews

We will conduct full in-person interview days in Cebu on September 22 and Manila on September 24. Strong applicants who can attend one of those days should make sure their current city is clear in the application. The internship itself is remote.



Application Process

Complete the Intern application form:





Choose the team that interests you and identify the role or roles that best fit. Include your CV. If the role is creative, technical, curriculum-related, or otherwise sample-driven, include a portfolio or work link.



Attentiveness Check

Write "Build" in your subject line. Applications that ignore this instruction may not be reviewed.



One Last Thing

If you are looking for easy hours, a certificate with minimal work, or an internship where nobody expects much from you, this is not the right fit.



If you want paid experience, real responsibility, direct feedback, and a chance to turn good work into a longer-term role, apply.
