title: People & Culture Operations Specialist
description:
We’re Hiring: People & Culture Operations Specialist

100% Remote | Full-Time



We are seeking a detail-focused and highly dependable People & Culture Operations Specialist to help manage the operational side of our global HR function.



Working closely with the Head of People & Culture, you will help ensure that employee records, HR systems, payroll-related updates, recruitment coordination, training requirements, leave administration, and other People & Culture activities are handled accurately and on time.



This position is well suited to someone who is comfortable taking ownership of administrative processes, coordinating with employees and managers across different countries and time zones, keeping track of multiple deadlines, and following tasks through to completion.



What You’ll Be Responsible For:



Employee & HR Operations

-Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Head of People & Culture.

-Manage administrative activities throughout the employee journey, from hiring to separation.

-Prepare employment-related documents, including offer letters, promotion letters, salary adjustment letters, employment changes, probation documentation, and other employee correspondence.

-Organize onboarding and offboarding requirements and coordinate with the relevant stakeholders to complete each step.

-Keep employee files and HR documentation complete, accurate, and up to date.

-Record employee changes appropriately across relevant HR and payroll systems.

-Maintain HR calendars, trackers, checklists, and other tools used to monitor recurring activities and deadlines.

-Assist with recurring and annual People & Culture initiatives.

-Handle confidential employee information responsibly and use appropriate discretion.

-BambooHR & HRIS Management



Take ownership of day-to-day BambooHR administration, including:

-Updating employee profiles and employment information.

-Recording new hires, promotions, compensation changes, employee departures, and other lifecycle updates.

-Managing employee leave and time-off records.

-Keeping organizational and reporting information current.

-Supporting workflows, approvals, documentation, and employee records within BambooHR.

-Assisting with the BambooHR Applicant Tracking System and related recruitment activities.

-Preparing and maintaining HR reports.

-Regularly reviewing HR data to identify incomplete, outdated, or incorrect information.

-Assisting employees and managers with routine BambooHR-related questions.

-Looking for ways to make better use of BambooHR and reduce unnecessary manual HR processes.

-Establishing and maintaining clear procedures for HRIS administration.

-BambooHR experience is highly preferred. Candidates who have administered another HRIS may also be considered if they have strong relevant experience and can quickly adapt to new systems.



Payroll Coordination

-Support payroll administration for employees in the United States and United Kingdom by:

-Preparing and reviewing employee updates that affect payroll.

-Coordinating new employee additions and terminations with payroll.

-Processing salary increases, promotions, bonuses, and other compensation updates.

-Checking that leave and employee status changes are properly reflected in payroll.

-Reviewing payroll information for accuracy before processing.

-Maintaining supporting documentation and securing required internal approvals.

-Investigating discrepancies and coordinating necessary corrections.

-Keeping records of payroll changes and their effective dates.

-Working with Finance, payroll providers, and the Head of People & Culture when required.



Previous experience supporting U.S. and/or UK payroll administration is strongly preferred.

-Leave & Time-Off Support

-Handle the administrative coordination of employee leaves of absence.

-Keep leave-related records, documentation, correspondence, and dates accurate within the HRIS.

-Support maternity, parental, medical, and other applicable leave processes.

-Ensure required approvals and documentation are collected and properly maintained.

-Monitor key leave dates and follow up on outstanding requirements.

-Administer company time-off policies through BambooHR.

-Respond to routine employee questions concerning leave and time-off procedures.

-Escalate complex leave, legal, or employee-relations concerns to the Head of People & Culture.

-Apply leave and time-off procedures consistently according to company policies.



Recruitment Coordination

Provide administrative support across the hiring process, including:

-Arranging interviews across different time zones.

-Coordinating candidate availability with hiring teams.

-Keeping candidate information and recruitment activities updated in the ATS.

-Managing candidate communications during the recruitment process.

-Coordinating interview schedules and following up with interviewers.

-Preparing offer documentation and assisting with the candidate-to-employee transition.

-Coordinating pre-employment and onboarding requirements.

-Maintaining recruitment trackers and monitoring candidate progress.

-Supporting the Head of People & Culture and hiring managers with additional recruitment-related activities.



Training & Compliance

-Manage administrative activities within the company’s employee training platform.

-Assign required training to employees.

-Monitor completion of mandatory and role-specific training.

-Follow up on incomplete training requirements.

-Maintain training records and completion reports.

-Assist with implementing new policies, procedures, and required employee acknowledgements.

-Maintain documentation related to policy acknowledgements and other required records.

-Support compliance monitoring and reporting activities.

-People & Culture Support



The People & Culture inbox will be an important part of your day-to-day responsibilities.

You will:

-Monitor incoming employee and manager requests.

-Ensure questions and requests receive timely responses.

-Handle routine HR and policy-related inquiries when appropriate.

-Direct matters to the appropriate People & Culture team member or internal stakeholder.

-Monitor open requests until they are fully resolved.

-Follow up with employees, managers, or stakeholders when additional information or action is needed.

-Recognize urgent, sensitive, or complex matters and escalate them promptly.

-Help provide employees with a professional, responsive, and supportive People & Culture experience.



HR Policies & Compliance

-Become familiar with the company’s employee handbook, HR policies, and internal procedures.

-Support the consistent application of established HR policies.

-Maintain and update HR templates, documentation, procedures, and employee-facing materials.

-Assist with policy rollouts and employee acknowledgement activities.

-Keep current policy and procedure records organized.

-Prior exposure to U.S. and UK employment practices and employment law is preferred.

-Identify matters that require escalation rather than attempting to independently resolve complex legal or employee-relations issues.



Process Improvement & HR Organization

A key focus of this position is helping create a more organized, efficient, consistent, and scalable People & Culture operation.

You will be expected to:

-Evaluate current HR processes and identify areas where efficiency and accuracy can be improved.

-Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, templates, trackers, and other process documentation.

-Establish repeatable approaches for recurring People & Culture activities.

-Identify manual tasks that can be simplified, standardized, or automated.

-Help clarify ownership and deadlines for recurring HR activities.

-Keep electronic employee and departmental records well organized.

-Make HR information easy to find, understand, and hand over when necessary.

-Monitor outstanding actions and ensure they are followed through to completion.

-Assist the Head of People & Culture with ad hoc projects, reporting, audits, and other operational initiatives.



What We’re Looking For



Must-Have Qualifications:

-At least 2 years of professional experience in Human Resources, People Operations, HR Operations, or a related HR function.

-Strong English communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate HR decisions and information.

-Demonstrated ability to independently manage HR administrative activities such as employee records, documentation, trackers, onboarding/offboarding, training or learning-management platforms, and recurring HR processes.

-Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word, including spreadsheets, employee data, reports, trackers, and HR documentation.

-Hands-on experience with an HRIS and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) or employee management system. BambooHR experience is strongly preferred, while comparable HRIS experience may also be considered.

-Excellent attention to HR data accuracy, documentation, organization, and confidentiality, particularly when handling compensation, payroll, leave, and employment information.

-Strong ownership and follow-through, with the ability to prioritize tasks, solve problems, manage multiple deadlines and stakeholders, and work with minimal supervision.

-Experience using recruitment workflows and Applicant Tracking Systems.

mbers to rapidly ideate, plan, specify, build, and test our platform's features (such as Intake AI, Protocol Generator, and After Care tools). *****

title: Financial Analyst — Business Valuation & Market Research (Project-Based)
description:
About the role



I own a financial services firm in the US serving small businesses. I need valuations and industry research for specific companies, one engagement at a time.



Each project has a defined scope and a deadline. Do good work and there will be more — this can become steady, recurring work.



I provide access to the paid research platforms needed for the job. You bring the analysis.



What you'll own



Business valuations using the income, market, and asset-based approaches

Industry research: what revenue and EBITDA/SDE multiples apply to a given industry, and why

Comparable transaction and comparable company analysis

Market research at three levels — national, state, then county or metro

Pulling data from paid platforms I provide, plus public sources, and telling me plainly how reliable each source is

A clean written deliverable with assumptions visible and reasoning that holds up to questioning



Requirements



Background in valuation, financial modeling, audit, or transaction advisory. You don't need "valuation analyst" in your job title — you need to have done the work.

Solid grasp of valuation methodology: DCF, market multiples, SDE vs. EBITDA, normalization adjustments, discount rates

You understand why multiples differ by industry and can explain it in plain language

Strong Excel or Google Sheets. You build models, not fill in templates.

Comfortable with research databases. I provide subscription access — you need to know how to use these tools and where their data has gaps.

Able to work down to county and metro level, not just national averages

Extremely organized. Assumptions documented, sources cited, nothing hand-waved.

Written and spoken English strong enough for live calls and clean written deliverables

Available for calls during a set overlap window with US Central Time



Nice to have



CPA, CFA, or progress toward either

Big 4 or mid-tier audit background

US market experience, especially Texas

Small business valuations, not just large-cap

Hands-on with BizBuySell, DealStats, IBISWorld, PitchBook, or similar

Industry research or market sizing experience



How you'll communicate with me



I'm busy and I d
 fast. Your reporting should be:



Short. Bullets, not paragraphs. Lead with the conclusion.

Visual where it helps. A table or chart beats a wall of text.

Decision-oriented. Give me the number, the range, and what drives it.



Channels: Teams is primary. iMessage or WhatsApp for urgent items. Video calls with camera on are required — you'll walk me through your findings and defend your assumptions live, not just send a file.



Access and security



Read-only access to whatever financial records an engagement requires, plus a dedicated inbox for project materials — not my personal accounts. No shared logins. Research platform access is provided under my subscription and is for my engagements only. Client information is confidential; you'll sign an NDA before the first project.



How to apply



Read this carefully. Applications that skip a step get deleted without a reply.



Start your message with the word MULTIPLE on its own first line.

Attach one piece of analytical work you produced — a valuation, a financial model, a market research report, or a comparable company analysis. Redact company names and anything confidential. Your own work only, not a template or a class project.

Write a summary of that file's conclusion as if you were sending it to me. Maximum 100 words, bullets only.

Record a video under 2 minutes, camera on: your name, your background, and a walkthrough of the file — specifically, how you arrived at your key assumption and why you're confident in it.

In one or two sentences: name an industry you've analyzed and where you found the multiple or benchmark data for it.

Tell me your rate — per project or per hour — and what text app you use.

title: Video Editor | AI Content & Social Media
description:
Video Editor | AI Content & Social Media



BrandFi is looking for a reliable video editor who can turn raw footage, creative briefs, and brand assets into polished content for client brands and our own projects.



You should be confident with traditional editing software and AI tools, with a strong eye for pacing, storytelling, and design. We need someone who can work independently, follow clear direction, and deliver on time.

* Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube Shorts, and social media ads.

* Promotional videos, product content, and website videos.

* Turning longer videos into focused, engaging clips.

* AI-generated visuals, video sequences, and voiceovers where they improve the final result.

* Captions, motion graphics, sound design, colour correction, and audio cleanup.

* Adapting videos for different platforms, formats, and brand styles.



Tools and skills



You should be comfortable with professional editing tools such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut. Experience with After Effects or similar motion graphics software is an advantage.



You should also have practical experience using AI tools in your workflow. Tell us which tools you use, what you use them for, and show examples of the finished work.



We care about the quality of your output, not how many tools you list.

* Strong hooks, clean edits, readable captions, and clear messaging.

* Content that fits the brand instead of relying on the same templates and effects.

* Fast delivery without careless mistakes.

* Clear communication and consistent progress updates.

* Confirmation of the brief and delivery date before starting.

* Early notice of blockers or missing materials.

* Organized project files and editable source files at handoff.

* Respect for client confidentiality and proper use of licensed footage, music, and other assets.



You’ll work with our team across several projects. Stay focused on your assignments, ask relevant questions, and take responsibility for your deadlines.



How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction and your relevant experience.

2. Three to five of your strongest video examples, including short-form content and at least one example using AI.

3. What you personally created in each example and which tools you used.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 30–60-second video, including what that estimate covers.

5. Your weekly availability, time zone, and earliest start date.

6. Your expected rate and preferred payment structure.



We’re looking for someone we can build a consistent working relationship with. Strong editing matters, and so do reliability, communication, and follow-through.

title: Amazon Support & PPC Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are a fast-growing snack brand creating inclusive, better-for-you products made without the top nine allergens. We're looking for an experienced Amazon Support & PPC Specialist to help manage and grow our Amazon business while supporting advertising across other key retail platforms.



This role primarily focuses on the day-to-day management and optimization of Amazon — including PPC advertising, marketplace operations, profitability tracking, and performance analysis. We're looking for someone who has previously managed Amazon accounts for CPG, food, beverage, or consumer brands, speaks the language fluently, and can work independently to identify opportunities, solve problems, and drive results.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: $10 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon PPC & Performance



Own the day-to-day management and optimization of Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant ad formats

Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, and competitor research

Optimize bids, budgets, targeting, and campaign structures

Launch and manage new campaigns and testing initiatives

Monitor ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CPC, conversion, and overall sales performance

Track profitability at the ASIN/SKU level, including COGS and FBA fees

Identify underperforming areas and proactively recommend improvements

Provide clear, direct weekly reporting on performance, learnings, and recommended next steps



2. P&L & Profitability Management



Own and maintain a clear view of Amazon P&L — tracking revenue, ad spend, FBA fees, COGS, and overall profitability

Proactively flag margin risks, identify opportunities to improve profitability, and contribute to commercial decision-making

Translate data into actionable insights the team can act on quickly



3. Listing Optimization & Content



Review and optimize Amazon product listings including titles, bullet points, imagery, and product content

Collaborate with the team on A+ Content, video, and creative assets

Maintain and improve the Amazon Storefront

Ensure listings remain accurate, conversion-focused, and brand-aligned

Monitor competitor activity and category trends



4. Retail Media — Instacart & Other Platforms



Manage Instacart advertising including campaign setup, bidding, optimization, and performance monitoring

Apply Amazon PPC learnings and best practices across Instacart and other retail media platforms

Monitor spend and performance across channels and identify areas for optimization

Support advertising associated with Whole Foods Market where relevant



5. Account Health & Operations



Monitor account health and proactively flag potential issues

Raise and manage Amazon Seller Support cases, following issues through to resolution

Troubleshoot listing, inventory, fulfillment, and account-related issues

Support inventory and logistics coordination to maintain product availability



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon marketplace and Amazon PPC experience; demonstrated experience managing Amazon accounts for CPG, food, beverage, snack, or consumer brands

Instacart: Hands-on Instacart Ads experience is a must-have — campaign setup, optimization, and performance management

P&L Management: Demonstrated ability to manage and track Amazon P&L, including profitability at ASIN/SKU level, COGS, and FBA fees — must-have

Performance: Able to provide clear examples demonstrating measurable improvements in sales, ACOS, ROAS, or profitability

Amazon Fluency: Deep understanding of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Ads, FBA operations, and listing optimization; experience managing and resolving Seller Support cases

Communication: Clear, direct, and concise communicator — able to answer questions directly, provide actionable weekly reporting, and flag issues without ambiguity; candidates who are expansive but indirect will not be the right fit

title: AP/AR Accountant – Finance Ops (US Focus)
description:

While the role includes core Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable responsibilities, this position is also heavily focused on Finance Operations support, issue resolution, process ownership, and cross-functional coordination.



This is not a purely transactional accounting role. We are looking for someone who can independently manage workflows, proactively resolve accounting and operational issues, identify process gaps, and help improve overall finance operations with minimal supervision.



The ideal candidate has strong experience in AP/AR operations, reconciliations, billing, collections, payment tracking, and financial transaction processing, along with the ability to work cross-functionally and thrive in a fast-paced environment.



This role is ideal for accounting professionals who are highly organized, process-driven, solutions-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities from start to finish.

• US accounting and finance environments

• AP/AR and finance operations roles

• Accounts Payable operations

• Accounts Receivable management

• Process improvement initiatives

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent communication and issue-resolution abilities

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities

• Ability to manage deadlines and high-volume operations effectively



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in multi-entity accounting operations

• Exposure to month-end close and reporting processes

• Experience handling high-volume AP/AR operations

• Knowledge of US accounting practices and compliance requirements

• Experience working in fast-paced or high-growth environments

title: Growth Campaign Operator
description:
Who you would be working for:



My Legal Academy is a tech-forward growth infrastructure company for law firms, founded in 2019 and based in Woodland Hills, California. We do not sell marketing services. We install and operate complete growth systems inside small US law firms: intake, CRM, follow up automation, and paid acquisition. We have worked with more than 2,000 firms, and the metric we are judged on is signed cases, not clicks.

That distinction matters for this role. A campaign that produces cheap leads nobody signs is a failed campaign here. You will be looking at cost per signed case as often as cost per lead.



What you would own:



You will manage two campaign portfolios end to end. You are not handing creative to a designer and media buying to a specialist. You are the person who takes a budget, a practice area, and a market, and comes back with a campaign that works.



Internal Campaigns

MLA's own lead generation. Paid social and search driving attorneys into our Revenue Leak Audit call, plus webinar and program launch campaigns. You own budget allocation, creative, targeting, and the numbers we review weekly.



Client Campaigns

Paid acquisition for law firm clients across personal injury, estate planning, immigration, family, and business law. Multiple accounts at once, each with its own market, budget, and partner who wants to know where the money went.



Creative Production

Creating or assisting the team with ad concepts, hooks, copy, static and video creative, and the testing plan behind them. You generate variants at volume with AI, then apply taste to decide which ones ship.



Funnels and Follow-up

Landing pages, lead magnets, forms, and the GoHighLevel automations behind them. A lead that lands in a CRM and gets no follow up is a lead we paid for and lost, so the funnel is part of the campaign, not a separate job.



The Differentiator



How we work with AI

This is the part of the job that is not standard, and the part we will screen hardest on. Our team runs on Claude. Not as a novelty and not as a copywriting shortcut, but as the default way work gets done. The people who do well here have restructured how they work around it.



In practice that means you are expected to build your own tooling rather than wait for someone to build it for you. Set up Claude Projects with your account context so you are not re-explaining a client every session. Write prompts that produce forty ad variants worth reading instead of four that need rewriting. Hand a spend export to Claude and get the analysis back in minutes rather than building the pivot table yourself. Draft the client performance summary, then edit it, rather than starting from a blank page.



We are not looking for someone who has heard of AI. We are looking for someone whose current output would drop by half if you took the tools away. If that describes you, the take-home task below will be easy and you should apply.



What you need to have



Experience: Two or more years running paid campaigns with real budget across Meta and Google. You have managed money that was not yours and reported on it to someone who cared. 

AI Fluency: Genuine daily use, particularly with Claude, including maintaining your own prompt library and knowing what these tools are bad at. You will be asked to show your work.

Creative Range: Ability to write a hook, and build a static creative that stops a scroll either using AI or other no code tools. 

Data & Metrics: Comfort with CPL, CPA, ROAS, cost per signed case, and the transparency to surface underperforming campaigns promptly.

Communication: Written English proficiency strong enough for writing copy for US attorneys and performance summaries for partners.

Availability: Full overlap with US Pacific business hours.

Setup: Reliable workstation, stable internet with a backup connection, and a quiet environment for client calls.



Strong Plus

GoHighLevel: Builder-level experience with sub-accounts, snapshots, workflows, pipelines, and calendars.

Funnel Building: Experience building landing pages across GHL, Webflow, Framer, or custom builds.

US Legal Market: Prior experience in legal lead generation, particularly personal injury.

Video Editing: Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere, Descript, or AI-assisted video production.

Technical AI: Familiarity with Claude Code, MCP servers, or scripting for reporting automation.

Copywriting & CRO: Background in conversion copywriting or conversion rate optimization.



Not a Fit If

We would rather you self-select out now than discover it in week three.



You require a detailed brief before you can start executing.

Your experience is strictly limited to agency roles where others handled client relationships and budget management.

You use AI tools to generate content without editing or reviewing it yourself.

You intend to negotiate away working US Pacific hours after joining.

You plan to manage this alongside another full-time position.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO | E-commerce & Operations
description:
Take work off the CEO's plate. That is the whole job.



Graphene-X is a performance apparel brand built on graphene, aerogel and boron nitride. 14 Kickstarter campaigns funded, $3M+ raised from 30,000+ backers in 100+ countries, zero failed deliveries, and winner of the ISPO Innovation Prize 2024.



Products ship to customers in the US, Canada, UK and Europe through Shopify and Kickstarter.



The employer is Ikigai Ventures Limited (Hong Kong), the company behind Graphene-X and the CEO's other ventures. Graphene-X will take most of your time. The rest will go to those ventures.



You work directly with the CEO.



Nothing the CEO is waiting on goes unchased. That is the standard you are measured against.



You start from clear instructions. As your judgment and execution prove out, you take ownership of more.



What you will do

Ledger and launches

Run the weekly request ledger. Every open item has an owner, a due date and a next follow-up.

Chase deliverables from the team — design, growth, customer support and operations — until they land.

Build and maintain the launch checklist for every Shopify launch and Kickstarter campaign: photos, copy, product data, video scripts, owners and dates.

Inbox, calendar and travel

Triage the CEO's
 daily and draft replies in clean, fluent English.

Keep the inbox fully processed by the end of each working day, with every pending matter actioned, delegated, scheduled or tracked for follow-up.

Manage the CEO's calendar and protect focus blocks.

Book flights, hotels, meetings and other travel logistics.

Turn open questions into concise, one-page recommendations with a clear answer.

Maintain trackers, spreadsheets and internal documentation.

Build small automations that remove recurring manual work.



As you earn trust, the role will grow into supplier follow-ups — samples, prototypes, production dates and reports — and wider operational ownership.



Who you are



Organized. Things do not fall through the cracks.



Persistent. If someone owes you an answer, document or deliverable, you follow up until you have it.



Proactive. You act before anyone reminds you.



Fast. You find the shortest route to done.



Resourceful. When you do not know something, you figure it out.



Detail-oriented. Names, numbers, dates, attachments and instructions matter.



Discreet. You will handle confidential commercial and financial information.



Fluent in English, written and spoken.



Comfortable with high standards and a fast pace.



AI proficiency



You use ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools regularly, and you have built at least one workflow with them that replaced or significantly reduced manual work.



You will show it to us.



Tools



Gmail · Google Calendar · Slack · Notion · Google Sheets · Shopify



A plus:



Klaviyo · Kickstarter · BackerKit · Zapier · Make · n8n



New tools are part of the job. You pick them up fast.



Working hours & holidays



This is a full-time, remote, long-term position working Hong Kong hours, Monday to Friday.



The position follows the Hong Kong working calendar and Hong Kong public holidays, not the Philippines public holiday calendar.



If a day is a public holiday in the Philippines but a normal working day in Hong Kong, you will be expected to work as usual.



Hong Kong public holidays observed by the company will be treated as holidays.



There is no US night shift.



Occasional flexibility may be required when something genuinely urgent needs solving.



Compensation



₱47,000–₱63,000/month, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



There will be a performance review after 90 days, with a defined path to higher compensation as responsibility and ownership grow.



By day 90



Success means:



You run the request ledger without prompting.

The CEO's inbox is fully processed every evening.

Every upcoming launch has a checklist with owners and dates at least two weeks before its gate.

The CEO can clearly identify a significant amount of operational workload that is no longer on his plate.

How to apply



Skip the cover letter.



Start your application with the exact sentence:



“I like getting things done.”



Then send:



Your CV.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Your current employment situation and earliest possible start date.

A link to a 60–90 second video in English introducing yourself and explaining why you fit this role.

Tell us about an executive, founder or manager you have supported before. What did you take off their plate?

Describe one workflow you built or automated using ChatGPT, Claude or another AI tool. What did it replace, and approximately how much time did it save?

Confirm that you are comfortable working Hong Kong hours and following the Hong Kong public holiday calendar rather than the Philippines holiday calendar.

title: Closer
description:
📣 WE’RE HIRING: CLOSER | REMOTE & SEASONAL

📅 Season: November–March

💻 100% Remote

💰 starting @ $8 USD/hour + Commission



Avenue Tax Service is looking for a confident, friendly, and dependable Closer to join us for tax season.



If you’re good with people, comfortable talking on the phone, and know how to turn an interested lead into a signed client, this could be a great fit.



No tax experience is required — we’ll train you.



What’s the role?

•You’ll work with warm, opted-in leads, meaning people who have already shown interest in our tax services. You’ll also reconnect with past clients who may be ready to file with us again.

•Your job is to take care of the client from the first conversation through the final steps of the process.

•You’ll learn what they need, explain how we can help, answer questions about pricing, collect their documents, and confidently ask them to move forward with us.



Our tax preparers handle the tax return. You handle the client relationship.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Talk with warm leads and reconnect with past clients

• Have friendly, professional conversations with U.S. clients

• Learn about each client’s situation and what they need

• Collect the documents and information needed to move forward

• Follow up consistently so interested clients don’t get forgotten

• Clearly explain our services, pricing, and available options

• Handle questions or concerns about pricing professionally

• Help clients understand the value of working with us

• Confidently ask clients to move forward when they’re ready

• Keep accurate and updated notes in our CRM

• Hand off complete and organized information to the tax preparer

• Stay in touch with clients through signing and other final steps



What We’re Looking For

✅ We’re looking for someone who is friendly, confident, organized, and comfortable talking to people.



You may be a good fit if you have:

✅ Experience in sales, customer service, inside sales, appointment setting, client success, or another client-facing role

✅ Clear, easy-to-understand English and confidence speaking with U.S. clients

✅ A natural and genuine way of communicating with people

✅ Experience handling questions like “Why does it cost this much?” without immediately offering a discount

✅ Strong follow-up habits — you don’t let good leads disappear

✅ Comfort working with a CRM and managing several active clients

✅ The ability to stay organized and move quickly during busy periods

✅ A willingness to follow our process, accept feedback, and learn

✅ High integrity when handling private personal and financial information



Tax experience is NOT required. We’ll teach you what you need to know about our process and systems.



A Quick Note About Tax Season

•This is a fast-paced role, especially during our busiest weeks.

•You may be helping several clients at the same time, so you need to be comfortable staying organized, following up, and keeping things moving without making clients feel rushed.



If you enjoy talking with people, solving problems, following up, and working toward results, you’ll probably enjoy this role.



The Details

🕘 Schedule: Full availability from November through March

Core hours: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Please note that some peak-season days, especially in December, may require additional hours.

💰 starting @ $8 USD/hour + commission on successfully closed clients

💻 Type: Remote | Independent Contractor | Seasonal

🎓 Training: Paid training on our systems, services, and client process

🌱 Long-Term Opportunity: This is a seasonal position, but we’re building a long-term team. Strong performers may be considered first for future or year-round opportunities.



Interested in joining our team? We’d love to learn more about you!



To get started, please click the link below and complete our short prescreening.

👉 Start your prescreening here: 

🎥 A quick heads-up: Most questions will require a video response, so please be camera-ready and presentable. There’s no need to be overly formal, just be yourself, speak clearly, and answer each question thoughtfully.



Please take your time and make sure you complete all the required questions.



We look forward to learning more about you and potentially welcoming you to our team!

description:
Senior Logistics Specialist

Tank Stream Design  Remote



About Us

Born and bred on the Gold Coast of Australia, our company designs and develops unique lifestyle apparel and accessories for quality retailers around the world. Our market leading resort, sunglass and headwear brands are designed and developed to the highest standards by our talented in-house team with an eye for quality, attention to detail and a passion for the outdoor lifestyle.



From humble beginnings, we have experienced continuous growth over the last 22 years. We are now stocked in retailers all over Australia, New Zealand, the Caribbean, Canada and the USA. We have established an excellent reputation for innovative and quality products that our retailers and consumers love equally.



The Position

As our Senior Logistics Specialist, you will orchestrate the seamless flow of goods from suppliers across Asia, through our Malaysia bonded hub, and into our AU (Burleigh Heads) and US (Vista) warehouses. If you thrive on optimizing landed costs, ensuring DIFOT (Delivered In Full, On Time), and leading cross-functional teams, this is your opportunity to drive global growth.

Key Responsibilities:

• Supplier Booking Governance:  Validate bookings, enforce incoterm compliance, and approve routing/consolidation plans to support ATS.

• End to End Execution:  Track cargo from ex-factory to departure, and manage milestone visibility through to custom clearance. 

• Freight Relationship Owner:  Ensure freight and inland costs from port are managed and that service lead times are met within the network.

• Hub and Transfer Management:  Oversee our Malaysia bonded 3PL hub and execute disciplined AU/US inter-company transfers. 

• Compliance and Documentation:  Ensure flawless global trade compliance (FTAs, HS codes, CPSA/ACE) and accuracy of CI, PL, COO and BOL..

• Cost Ownership:  Maintain transactional accuracy in SAP B1, manage freight invoices, and optimise landed costs

• Operations Handover:  Drive a ‘zero surprise’ inbound environment by early advising shipments and ensuring flawless document handovers.



About You / Qualifications:

Experience & Expertise:

• 7+ years in global logistics, freight forwarding, or inbound supply chain execution

• Deep understanding of incoterms, FTAs, tariffs and landed cost components

• Proficiency in SAP B1 and global forwarder portals

• Proven track record of managing bonded hubs and consolidation networks.

• Strong communication, escalation and stakeholder alignment skills.

• Delivery focused with strong cost, speed and service balance.

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to lead change, uplift team maturity and align cross functional stakeholders





`For you:

We offer a highly competitive salary and as a valued member of our team, you'll play a pivotal role in our company's success, and you will be part of a collaborative and passionate team.

We're a genuine, rapidly growing, business in a vibrant Burleigh Heads location with bright, clean, sunny offices. We are deeply invested in our staff's well-being, and we actively support environmental initiatives.

We prioritise work-life balance and prioritise the personal well-being of our employees. Moreover, we're committed to fostering growth and development opportunities, both personally and professionally, and we have a culture of nurturing talent from within. If you possess the skills and experience to help us succeed, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity.



Our great company culture is rooted in our core values.



We warmly welcome people from a wide range of backgrounds that love adventure, design, nature and enabling our customers to enjoy their life more. People like you, help us get better daily.

Avoid blurry images, duplicates, poor angles, closed eyes, unflattering photos, and excessive versions of essentially the same shot.

Use AI photo-culling tools when helpful to identify duplicates, blurry images, etc., but final selections must be reviewed by a person.

Upload selected photos to Flickr.

Create and properly name Flickr albums by trip/destination.

Maintain the existing organization of the photos.

Experience I'm Looking For



You should have experience with photo curation, photography, social media content selection, website image selection, or visual content management.



Experience with Flickr is preferred but not required if you are comfortable learning it quickly.



You should be able to explain how you d
 which photos are strong enough to represent a brand, not simply upload whatever looks okay.



Important



I do not need someone to organize my Google Drive. The trip folders are already organized.



The main job is:



Review every image → choose the best → upload and categorize the final selections in Flickr.



This is not simply an AI scanning project. AI may assist with the first round of culling, but I expect you to personally review the final selections.



To Apply



Please answer these questions:



Have you curated photos for a website, social media account, photographer, travel company, or other brand?

What tools have you used for photo selection/culling?

Have you worked with Flickr?

If a folder contained 500 travel photos, briefly explain how you would narrow those down to the best photos for a travel website.

Please provide an example of previous photo curation, photography, social media, or visual content work.
